title: AI Architect
description:
Job Description :

We are looking for a senior architect to own the end-to-end technical architecture of a production-grade, multi-agent AI platform deployed in US regulated financial institutions. This is not an advisory or strategy role; it is a hands-on architecture role with accountability for system design decisions that affect security, regulatory compliance, scalability, and operational reliability.

The platform operates in some of the most demanding technical environments in enterprise software: BYOC deployments inside bank Azure and GCP tenants, confidential computing enclaves, offline cryptographic licensing, and HITL-governed agentic pipelines that must produce immutable audit trails defensible to federal regulators. Every architectural decision has regulatory implications.

Scope of Responsibility :

Platform Architecture :

- Own the overall technical architecture of a multi-agent AI platform defining component boundaries, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment topologies across cloud environments (Azure and GCP).

- Architect the Model Abstraction Layer decoupling agent orchestration logic from specific model providers and versions, enabling zero-downtime model upgrades and multi-cloud model serving flexibility.

- Define and maintain the Blue-Green deployment architecture parallel environment management, traffic shifting strategy, rollback procedures, and regression testing gates for model version changes.

- Design scalable Kubernetes-based deployment topology (AKS / GKE) node pool architecture, namespace isolation, pod security policies, Workload Identity Federation, resource quota management.

Security Architecture :

- Architect the BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) deployment model ensuring all platform components operate within the client institution's cloud tenant with zero data egress to Anaptyss infrastructure.

- Design the offline cryptographic licensing system RSA-4096 JWT-based license enforcement that operates without network dependency, supporting both air-gapped and hybrid deployment modes.

- Define encryption architecture : CMEK via Azure Key Vault / GCP Cloud KMS for at-rest encryption; TLS 1.3 for in-transit; confidential computing enclaves for in-processing.

- Architect network security posture : VPC Service Controls (GCP) / Azure Private Endpoints, Private Service Connect / Private Link for model serving, no public IP surfaces on core components.

- Define identity and access architecture : AAD/Entra ID or Google Cloud Identity SSO integration, Workload Identity Federation for service-to-service authentication, RBAC with principle of least privilege.

- Design audit logging architecture immutable audit trail system capturing every agent action, HITL decision, evidence retrieval, and output version in structured, tamper-evident form.

AI System Architecture :

- Architect the agentic pipeline framework multi-stage workflow orchestration, inter-agent communication protocols, state persistence across HITL gates, and graceful degradation on component failure.

- Define the RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architecture embedding model selection, vector store integration, chunking and indexing strategy, retrieval precision and recall optimisation, context window management for large document corpora.

- Design deterministic tool architecture separation of AI reasoning layer from data retrieval layer, tool interface contracts, error handling, evidence validation logic, and auditability of every data access operation.

- Architect stateless agent execution ensuring no cross-session memory accumulation, no passive learning from runtime data, and full reproducibility of pipeline outputs given equivalent inputs.

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture :

- Design multi-cloud deployment architecture supporting both Azure and GCP abstracting cloud-specific components behind common interfaces while leveraging cloud-native managed services appropriately on each platform.

- Architect data persistence layer: relational database (Azure SQL / Cloud SQL PostgreSQL) for structured outputs and audit trail; object storage (Azure Blob / GCS) for document and artefact storage with appropriate partitioning, indexing, retention, and CMEK encryption.

- Design observability architecture: telemetry strategy (Azure Monitor + App Insights / GCP Cloud Monitoring + Cloud Logging) that provides operational visibility while keeping all telemetry within the client's cloud tenant.

- Define container image supply chain security: image signing (Sigstore/Binary Authorization), registry architecture (Azure Container Registry / Google Artifact Registry), Kubernetes admission control for signature verification.

Integration Architecture :

- Design the enterprise system integration layer defining connectivity patterns for read-only evidence retrieval from ERP, identity/access management, GRC, and workflow systems across on-premises and cloud-hosted environments.

- Architect GRC platform integration defining output delivery formats (JSON, PDF, CSV), API-based and file-based delivery patterns, and data mapping between ANA's output schema and client GRC platform import specifications.

- Define the client deployment package architecture Helm charts, Terraform modules, container image delivery via shared registry, cryptographic signature verification, and zero-Anaptyss-access deployment process.

Required Experience & Skills :

Architecture & Systems Design - Essential :

- 8+ years in enterprise software architecture, with at least 3 years in AI/ML platform architecture.

- Demonstrable experience designing production systems that were deployed in regulated environments financial services, healthcare, government, or equivalent where architectural decisions had compliance and regulatory implications.

- Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture on Azure and/or GCP proven ability to design production systems using managed services, Kubernetes, IAM, encryption, and networking on at least one platform; working familiarity with the other.

- Experience designing BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) or tenant-isolated deployment models where customer data must remain within the customer's cloud environment.

- Hands-on experience with confidential computing Azure Confidential Computing (DCv3/Intel SGX), GCP Confidential VMs (AMD SEV/Intel TDX), or equivalent at the architecture level.

AI Platform Architecture - Essential :

- Deep understanding of LLM inference architecture model serving patterns, API integration, token economics, latency optimisation, and failure mode handling at production scale.

- Hands-on experience architecting agentic AI systems multi-agent orchestration, tool use frameworks, ReAct patterns, state management across agent handoffs.

- RAG system architecture experience embedding model selection and deployment, vector database design (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Vertex AI Vector Search, or equivalent), retrieval pipeline optimisation.

- LLMOps / MLOps architecture model versioning strategy, Blue-Green model deployment, regression testing gates, monitoring for model drift and output quality degradation.

- Understanding of LLM security attack surfaces prompt injection, data exfiltration via model outputs, context window manipulation and architectural mitigations.

Security Architecture - Essential :

- Cryptographic systems design asymmetric key cryptography (RSA), JWT architecture, offline license enforcement, key management lifecycle.

- Cloud security architecture encryption at rest (CMEK), encryption in transit (TLS), encryption in processing (confidential computing), secrets management, network perimeter design.

- Identity and access architecture SSO integration (SAML/OIDC), Workload Identity Federation, RBAC design, principle of least privilege applied at cloud IAM level.

- Audit logging and compliance architecture immutable log design, audit trail completeness, log retention and tamper-evidence for regulated environments.

- Familiarity with bank technology risk frameworks OCC guidelines, Federal Reserve SR Letters, FFIEC guidance sufficient to understand what an examiner will look for in a system architecture review.

Engineering Credibility - Essential :

- Ability to produce architecture artefacts that engineering teams can build from not high-level slides but component diagrams, data flow specifications, interface contracts, security boundary definitions, and deployment topology documentation.

- Experience producing technical documentation for external review by enterprise architecture teams, information security teams, model risk management functions, and regulatory examiners.

- Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript sufficient to review code, prototype architectural concepts, and engage credibly with engineering teams on implementation decisions.

Strong Advantages :

- Experience engaging directly with bank technology risk, information security, or enterprise architecture teams as a vendor having your architecture reviewed, questioned, and approved through institutional governance processes.

- Multi-cloud architecture experience having designed and deployed the same logical system on both Azure and GCP with appropriate cloud-native service mapping.

- Experience with confidential computing at implementation depth enclave programming, attestation, sealed storage.

- Background in designing licensing and IP protection systems for software deployed in customer environments.

- SOC 2 Type II audit preparation having worked with auditors to document and evidence security controls.

What We Offer :

- A technically demanding problem space that very few architect roles offer governed agentic AI in federally regulated environments, combining confidential computing, multi-cloud security, and LLM architecture.

- Exposure to the most technically sophisticated buyers in enterprise software bank CDOs, Chief AI Officers, and Enterprise Architects who will probe every architectural decision.

title: Warranty Field Project Manager
description:
BLOX is revolutionizing the construction industry by integrating advanced manufacturing principles with innovative technology to deliver high-quality, modular building solutions. We are driven by a mission to rethink how buildings are designed, fabricated, and delivered, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and sustainability.


Position Summary: BLOX is seeking a Warranty Field Project Manager to manage warranty claims through their full lifecycle, with a focus on vendor coordination, subcontractor management, and repair execution. This role ensures claims involving external parties move through the system efficiently and within established cost parameters, and serves as on-site BLOX representation for larger subcontractor repairs at warranty sites across multiple states.


Requirements

Job Responsibilities

• Serve as primary point of contact for vendor repair path warranty claims, coordinating vendor and subcontractor scheduling, scope verification, and work completion

• Evaluate assigned claims to determine the appropriate repair approach, required subcontractors or vendors, and scope and timeline expectations before work begins

• Own assigned claims from assignment through Work Complete status, with heaviest involvement on claims requiring significant subcontractor coordination

• Coordinate scheduling with the Warranty Field Operations Manager when claims require both subcontractor and BLOX crew involvement

• Track vendor response times and performance against established thresholds, and maintain records supporting vendor performance evaluation

• Manage vendor chargebacks and cost recovery when fault attribution supports it, and update fault attribution as information becomes available during the repair process

• Track repair costs against estimates, manage PO creation and approval, and ensure subcontractors and vendors are paid properly upon completion

• Flag cost overruns and scope changes to the Warranty Program Manager

• Serve as on-site BLOX representative for larger subcontractor repairs, conducting site visits to assess scope, verify work quality, and confirm completion

• Interface directly with facility contacts on assigned claims

• Maintain accurate and timely claim updates in Smartsheet and provide status reporting on active claims, vendor performance, and cost tracking

• Build and maintain partnerships with qualified trade contractors

• Manage special operations projects within the warranty team as assigned


Job Skills & Qualifications

• Experience as an Assistant Project Manager, Project Engineer, or similar role with a construction company

• Solid understanding of project management processes within a construction environment

• Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent claims across programs and geographies

• Working knowledge of general construction systems, including mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, architectural, and building envelope

• Ability to evaluate repair scope, assess workmanship quality, and coordinate across multiple trade disciplines in the field

• Strong vendor management and negotiation skills

• Proficiency with Smartsheet or similar project tracking tools and the Microsoft Office suite

• MEP or healthcare construction experience preferred

• Ability to travel approximately 50% on average, with the potential to increase to 65–70% as warranty volume grows; travel varies with claim volume


Benefits

BLOX offers the full spectrum of comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance. We also offer flexible spending accounts, paid time off, short term disability, long term disability, life insurance and a 401k plan.


BLOX believes in the growth of our people. We provide support for employees pursuing licenses/certifications, creating clear pathways for skill development and career advancement.


BLOX LLC is committed to making employment decisions based on an individual’s qualifications, performance, and ability to contribute to our team. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.


We are equally committed to maintaining a respectful and inclusive workplace. Harassment or discrimination of any kind based on a protected status is strictly prohibited.

title: Head - Enterprise Integration & Middleware
description:
Job Role : Head - Digitization

Division : Support Section : IT/ITES

Role Overview :

To build and continuously improve digital ecosystem so that applications, data and digital tools operate as one integrated platform rather than as separate systems. The role will own the enterprise integration, data and digital - enablement layer across the organisation and will work closely with the Head - IT, business functions, application owners and implementation partners.

This position will work closely with Operations, IT, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, and Leadership teams to build a data - driven and automated operations ecosystem.

Areas of Responsibilities Key Activities :

Essential Functions :

Key Responsibilities :

1. Enterprise Integration & Middleware :

- Own the architecture and implementation of the enterprise integration layer.

- Ensure ERP, CRM, PLM, WMS, MES / shopfloor systems, customer portals and custom applications exchange information through a structured middleware and API architecture.

- Define integration standards, interface ownership, monitoring and failure - handling practices.

- Reduce uncontrolled point - to - point integrations and prevent new application silos.

- Coordinate integration requirements across internal teams, application owners and technology partners.

2. Master Data Management & Data Governance:

Implement and operate an enterprise MDM framework that creates trusted common master data.

- Define the system of record, business owner, approval workflow and distribution rules for key masters such as customers, vendors, products/materials, locations, assets and other shared enterprise data.

- Drive data quality, de - duplication and consistent use of master data across systems.

- Establish practical governance for ownership, changes, exceptions and data stewardship.

3. Enterprise Data Platform / Data Lake:

Design and progressively implement the central enterprise data platform.

- Bring governed data from ERP, CRM, PLM, WMS, MES and other applications into a common Data Lake / Lakehouse architecture.

- Establish reliable data pipelines, data models, lineage and quality controls.

- Make enterprise data usable for reporting, analytics, automation and AI while maintaining traceability back to source systems.

4. Business Intelligence & Enterprise Reporting:

Create a common reporting architecture with the objective of establishing one version of the truth for management information.

- Standardise KPI definitions and common business data definitions.

- Enable dashboards, management reporting and drill - down analytics from governed enterprise data.

- Progressively reduce contradictory reports, spreadsheet - based reporting and independent reporting logic embedded across departments.

5. Enterprise Digital Platforms:

Own and improve common digital platforms used across multiple business functions.

- Document Management System (DMS): document storage, versioning, access, workflow and lifecycle.

- Knowledge Management System (KMS): capture, search and reuse of organisational knowledge.

- Low - Code / No - Code platforms: rapid digitisation of smaller workflows and applications within defined architecture and governance standards.

- Enterprise AI agents / copilots: controlled deployment of AI for knowledge retrieval, document analysis, engineering assistance, workflow support and repetitive business tasks.

- RPA and other automation technologies where they are the appropriate solution.

6. Process Digitisation & Automation:

Partner with business functions to identify and eliminate manual, repetitive and disconnected processes.

- Translate business requirements into practical technology solutions.

- Choose the simplest appropriate solution: improve the existing enterprise application first, then workflow / low - code, RPA, AI or custom development where justified.

- Drive digitisation of processes currently dependent on paper, email, spreadsheets or manual transfer of information between systems.

- Measure business outcomes such as cycle - time reduction, productivity improvement, error reduction and adoption.

7. Digital Architecture & Standards:

Under the overall technology architecture and governance of the CIO, establish standards for the digital layer.

- Define standards for integrations, APIs, data models, MDM, workflow platforms, low - code applications and AI agents.

- Ensure new solutions fit the enterprise architecture and do not create another generation of disconnected tools.

- Work with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions comply with enterprise security, access - control and technology standards.

8. Program, Vendor & Delivery Management:

- Convert business needs into clear BRDs / functional requirements and implementation plans.

- Support technology evaluation, vendor / SI selection, commercials and scope definition together with the CIO and relevant stakeholders.

- Manage implementation partners against agreed scope, timelines, cost, quality and business outcomes.

- Move initiatives from pilot to stable production and ensure ownership, support and adoption are established.

9. Adoption & Continuous Improvement:

- Track usage and adoption of digital platforms after implementation.

- Identify usability, process and data issues and drive continuous improvement.

- Build strong working relationships with business process owners and create appropriate functional ownership for digital solutions.

Candidate Profile:

- 12 - 18 years of relevant experience in enterprise applications, digital transformation, systems integration, data platforms or enterprise architecture.

- Strong preference for experience in a manufacturing, engineering or asset - intensive organisation.

- Demonstrated ability to translate business processes and requirements into scalable technology solutions.

- Experience working with implementation partners / system integrators and managing multi - functional technology programs.

- Ability to operate at both architecture and delivery level - technically strong enough to challenge vendors and design decisions, without needing to be the hands - on specialist in every platform.

Preferred Technical Exposure:

- ERP and surrounding enterprise systems such as CRM, PLM, WMS, MES and portals.

- Middleware, APIs and enterprise integration patterns.

- Master Data Management and data governance.

- Data Lake / Lakehouse / Data Warehouse platforms and enterprise data pipelines.

- BI and analytics platforms.

- DMS, KMS, workflow and Low - Code / No - Code platforms.

- AI / GenAI, enterprise agents / copilots and RPA.

Person Specification:

Education, Language, Specifications & Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. Relevant postgraduate qualifications or certifications in enterprise architecture, data, cloud or digital transformation are desirable.

- Process Automation Experience in Manufacturing Industries.

- Tenure Consistency.

- Flexible Mindset.

- Required 10 - 15 years of relevant experience in Project Deliveries & SAP Environment. Software Integration knowledge.

- Excellent written and spoken English. Should be from Mumbai.

title: Principal Architect -
description:
Role & Responsibilities :

You are the technical lead for a strategic project on LLM training. You own the complete projectfrom data mixture strategy to the final model evaluationensuring the project meets the client's domain-specific performance requirements within strict compute and data-privacy constraints.

Key Responsibilities :

- Lead the Training Roadmap : Define the stages of the LLM lifecycle : Continuous Pre-training (CPT) on domain-specific data, SFT, and alignment (DPO/PPO/RLHF).

- Architect Distributed Training Systems : Design the infrastructure for multi-node, multi-GPU training. You will make the call on using the right infrastructure.

- Data Mixture & Curriculum Design : Own the data strategy. You will decide the fine tuning between general-purpose data and domain-specific corpora to prevent catastrophic forgetting.

- Compute Budget & Optimization : Manage infrastructure optimize training efficiency (TFLOPS/GPU) and implement checkpointing strategies to ensure zero loss of progress during hardware failures.

- Evaluation Framework Design : Build a comprehensive, sovereign evaluation suite (beyond standard benchmarks) that measures the model's performance on the clients specific data.

- Direct Customer Delivery : Act as the primary technical point of contact for the customers team, translating their requirements into training approach and solution design.

Required Technical Skillset :

1. Distributed Training & Infrastructure :

- 3D Parallelism Mastery : Hands-on implementation of Data, Tensor, and Pipeline parallelism for models exceeding 70B parameters.

- Backend Optimization : Expert tuning to resolve bottlenecks in multi-node GPU clusters.

- Memory & Fault Tolerance : Mastery of ZeRO (Stages 13) and activation checkpointing; building automated, elastic training workflows for rapid failure recovery.

2. LLM Training Tricks & Stability :

- Convergence Engineering : Expertise in mitigating loss spikes, adaptive gradient clipping, and sophisticated LR schedules.

- Numerical Precision : Hands-on experience with Mixed Precision (BF16/FP16) and FP8 workflows, including dynamic loss scaling management.

- Advanced Optimization : Leveraging Grokking techniques and monitoring gradient health to adjust curriculum mid-run.

- Data Strategy : Implementing curriculum learning and domain-specific mixture ratios to prevent catastrophic forgetting during Continuous Pre-training (CPT).

3. Efficiency & Quantization Tricks :

- Advanced PEFT : Implementation of QLoRA, DoRA, and Rank-Stabilized LoRA to ensure fine-tuning performance matches full-parameter training.

- Inference-Aware Training : Utilizing Grouped Query Attention (GQA) and Multi-Query Attention (MQA) during training to optimize models for high-throughput deployment.

Required Qualifications :

- Experience : 15+ years in technology, with dedicated experience in design and development of transformer based AI/ML-based systems.

- GCP Mastery : Deep expertise in designing AI/ML solutions on GCP, specifically leveraging the Vertex AI ecosystem. A Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification is highly desirable.

- LLM Expertise : Hands-on experience architecting and delivering large-scale, production-grade AI systems, Proven experience in building and productionizing applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), including expertise in vector databases and model fine-tuning.

title: Director / Senior Director, Technical Operations
description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with neffy®, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Director / Senior Director, Technical Operations will provide strategic leadership for ARS' external manufacturing and Technical Operations activities supporting the continued development, lifecycle management, and commercial supply of neffy™. The successful candidate will combine strong technical, business, and operational leadership with cross-functional influence and CMO management expertise to drive manufacturing excellence, scalable operations, and reliable product supply.

This role is accountable for manufacturing strategy, CMO performance, process and technology lifecycle management, resolution of major technical issues, and execution of key Technical Operations initiatives across the ARS outsourced manufacturing network. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, the position leads complex cross-functional programs, oversees partner performance and agreements, manages departmental planning and budgets, and ensures technical, supply, regulatory, and business risks are appropriately identified, assessed, and escalated.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide leadership for Technical Operations programs and external manufacturing activities, establishing strategy, priorities, scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, budgets, risks, and key decision points.
  • Own senior-level Technical Operations relationships with key CMOs/CDMOs and other external partners; establish governance, performance expectations, escalation pathways, and accountability for delivery against manufacturing and business commitments.
  • Provide technical leadership for formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process characterization, process validation/PPQ, continued process verification, and manufacturing lifecycle management, as applicable.
  • Oversee clinical and commercial manufacturing strategy and execution in coordination with external manufacturers and internal stakeholders; ensure appropriate Technical Operations support for critical manufacturing campaigns, product launches, and supply requirements.
  • Provide senior technical review and oversight of manufacturing and process documentation, process performance, significant vendor changes, investigations, annual/product reviews, and significant deviations, out-of-specification or atypical results, and complex manufacturing problems; ensure robust technical investigation, root-cause analysis, effective corrective and preventive actions, continued process control, and reliable manufacturing in partnership with Quality Assurance.
  • Lead technical assessments of significant manufacturing, process, component, and supplier changes and coordinate evaluation of quality, regulatory, supply, financial, and business impacts with appropriate functional stakeholders.
  • Establish and review manufacturing, supply, and external partner performance metrics and KPIs, including service, quality, on-time delivery, right-first-time, cost, capacity, and other appropriate measures; drive lifecycle improvements, operational excellence, capacity planning, cost improvement, and risk-reduction initiatives across the external network.
  • Lead external partner business and technical governance, including selection and strategic development of CMOs, CDMOs, suppliers, and other critical partners; establish performance expectations and governance mechanisms, oversee business reviews, scopes of work, proposals, change orders, contract and supply agreement support, and escalation of commercial or operational issues; and develop business continuity, capacity, and second-source strategies for critical manufacturing capabilities and materials.
  • Represent Technical Operations on cross-functional program and leadership teams; communicate manufacturing strategy, program status, significant risks, financial implications, and recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs on CMC strategy, regulatory submissions, post-approval changes, and health authority responses; ensure manufacturing plans and technical decisions are aligned with regulatory commitments.
  • Lead Technical Operations business planning and continuous improvement initiatives, including departmental budget development with Finance/FP&A, contract lifecycle management, operational process standardization, and long-range manufacturing planning.
  • Provide leadership and governance for commercial supply operations managed within Technical Operations, including 3PL and distribution partner performance, inventory and supply continuity, shipping/returns interfaces, and support of product launches and new markets.
  • Oversee the commercial serialization program, including serialized packaging operations, EPCIS data exchange with trading partners and service providers, and compliance with applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements; ensure issues are appropriately escalated and resolved cross-functionally.
  • Provide leadership and oversight for clinical supply operations, including clinical material planning, packaging, labeling, distribution, inventory/expiry management, and coordination of Interactive Response Technology/Interactive Web Response System (IRT/IWRS) activities with Clinical Operations and external vendors.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Broad and deep knowledge of cGMP, pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality systems, formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process validation, lifecycle management, and applicable CMC regulatory expectations, with the technical credibility to critically challenge external partner data, conclusions, and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated leadership of outsourced manufacturing relationships, complex cross-functional programs, and teams, including governance, performance management, contract/scope management, budgeting, executive-level escalation, influence without direct authority, and accountability of external partners for performance and commitments.
  • Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving capability, with demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technical and business issues, balance risk, cost, supply continuity, and regulatory considerations, and make sound recommendations.
  • Excellent written, verbal, negotiation, and presentation skills with the ability to influence across functions and organizational levels and communicate effectively with senior management and external partners.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to translate budgets, forecasts, manufacturing costs, contract terms, and operational metrics into business decisions and actions.
  • Experience establishing scalable Technical Operations processes and systems; proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant project, reporting, or data-management tools.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of commercial and clinical supply operations within an outsourced model, including 3PL management, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and clinical supply/IRT/IWRS processes.
  • Must be able to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 25% to support external manufacturing partners, governance meetings, and key manufacturing activities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering, engineering, or related scientific/technical discipline; an advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) is preferred. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.
  • Minimum of 10+ years of relevant pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience in Technical Operations, manufacturing, process development, CMC, or related functions, with demonstrated leadership of complex programs and external manufacturing relationships.
  • Significant experience managing external CMOs/CDMOs in an outsourced operating model and supporting GMP clinical and commercial manufacturing is required.
  • Experience with drug-device combination products, nasal/inhalation products, sterile manufacturing, process validation/PPQ, commercial product launch, and lifecycle management is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting CMC regulatory strategy and submissions, major investigations and change controls, vendor/supply agreements, budget planning, and business continuity is preferred. Prior people-management or functional leadership experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience overseeing commercial distribution and 3PL partners, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and clinical supply operations including IRT/IWRS is strongly preferred; experience across multiple of these areas is preferred.
At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.
The full-time salary range for this posted position is $225,000 to $275,000 and may be eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus. Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

title: Senior Director, Trade Strategy, Distribution & Strategic Accounts
description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with neffy®, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

The Senior Director, Trade Strategy, Distribution & Strategic Accounts sets the strategy for all Trade Channel accounts, serves as the executive relationship lead for National Retail and other strategic trade partners, and is responsible for implementing and managing the day-to-day operations of ARS’ Trade and Distribution channels for our products. They will implement optimal network access for all new product launches across the entire Trade Channel to include 3PL, Wholesale, National Retail, Alternate Channel, Distribution, GPO, and Pharmacy partners. This role serves as the lead point of contact for all trade related activities, including distribution and trade contracting efforts for the entire product portfolio and developing business relationships with appropriate individuals within each assigned account. Beyond product availability, the role is accountable for identifying and growing trade partner opportunities that deliver measurable account growth and attractive channel economics.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs periodic business reviews and strategic planning meetings with Trade Channel partners, including National Retail accounts.
  • Serves as the executive relationship lead for National Retail and other strategic trade partners and maintains strong business relationships with key decision makers across purchasing, pharmacy operations, distribution, and finance.
  • Identifies and develops new growth opportunities with National Retail and other trade partners, translating them into joint business plans, negotiated initiatives, and measurable results.
  • Direct and oversee all partner activities, including, product handling and storage, inventory management, performance measurement for services provided by channel, audit support, and resolution of field issues (i.e., problems reported from providers/pharmacies, distributors, related to service and product access); establishes service-level expectations and serves as the senior escalation point for partner performance
  • Establishes and executes the multiyear U.S. trade and distribution strategy (channel architecture, partner mix, and service model) and any new product distribution strategy and launch preparedness, supported by business cases for channel expansion and strategic investments
  • Owns an end-to-end understanding of how product moves through every component of the channel, from 3PL and wholesaler through retail and specialty pharmacy to the patient, and proactively identifies potential marketplace trends/barriers and opportunities to accelerate or leverage trade partners, and creates strategies that will optimize access and create reimbursement confidence with providers and patients; advises commercial leadership on partner consolidation and emerging distribution and retail models
  • Owns trade activation and pull-through, ensuring contracted accounts can order, stock, and access product, resolving barriers such as item setup, eligibility, and ordering pathways, and distinguishing initial channel fill from sustained demand.
  • Collaborates with cross functional teams specific to SOP’s and contractual obligations associated with distribution infrastructure, reimbursement, marketing, pharmacovigilance, supply chain, quality assurance, patient services, legal, regulatory, TechOps, and finance
  • Negotiates and executes distribution and trade contracts including oversight and management of renewals, terms of sale, revenue recognition, payment/collections for product sales with all trade channel accounts, including National Retail, wholesalers, GPOs, buying groups, 3PLs, and specialty pharmacies; evaluates agreement economics and terms.
  • Monitors and maintains compliance to Prescription Drug Marketing Act (PDMA), Good Manufacturing Practice, Safety Health and Environmental, Sarbanes-Oxley, business procedures, raising and addressing issues as they arise; partners with Government Pricing, Legal, and Compliance before trade commitments are finalized
  • Aligns with Finance on managing accounting, pricing, GTN, inventory, forecasting and the trade operating budget
  • Ensures data integrity and adequate data flows and compliance between the company and distribution vendors and trade partners; partners with business analytics to develop and disseminate distribution and account related key performance indicators/analysis covering channel inventory, downstream demand, account penetration, and contract performance, and ensures accurate sales/shipment reporting to senior management
  • Proactively develops data-driven, defensible strategic recommendations for leveraging trade partners and presents them to the VP, Market Access, owning each recommendation from analysis through implementation.
  • Perform quarterly accuracy and completeness audits for finance and external auditors.
  • Builds and leads the trade function (including internal partners essential to trade/account work, supported by external partners as appropriate) directing vendors and cross functional workstreams against defined outcomes and budgets

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong understanding of various distribution and retail trade models, operation challenges and requirements to implement.
  • Ability to build relationships and expand company's presence with National Retail and distribution partners, with executive presence among senior trade and purchasing leaders.
  • Deep experience and strong understanding of Trade processes and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements, including government reporting and pricing considerations.
  • Strong commercial judgment, financial acumen, analytical, communication and negotiation skills, and broad understanding of Pricing and Contracting SOPs, practices, methodology, and approaches.
  • Strategic and rigorous analytical agility while using sound judgment to set objectives; naturally curious and proactive, approaching the role as a strategic owner
  • Leadership, presentation, and cross-functional interaction skills with a proven track record of delivering results, and the ability to build a function while remaining hands-on.
  • Strong diplomatic & interpersonal skills and able to inspire respect and trust from others, and ability to influence without authority.
  • Must be able to travel up to 35%, consistent with national account responsibilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Sales, Business Administration or Pharmaceutical related field required; advanced degree (e.g., MBA and/or CPA) preferred.
  • 12–15+ years relevant industry experience in the bio/pharmaceutical, and/or vaccines environment, including leadership responsibility in trade, distribution, or strategic accounts.
  • 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical industry experience working with payer / reimbursement/ wholesale/ specialty distributors, national retail, GPOs, and specialty pharmacies; strong understanding of typical functions and procedures.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating complex trade agreements, launching products, and delivering measurable account growth with national retail and other trade partners.

title: Salesforce Solution Architect
description:
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2-3 days in the office.

You will be required to interview in person.

About SailPoint :

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise.

Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job no more, no less.

Built on a foundation of AI and ML, our Identity Security Cloud Platform delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right timematching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of todays cloud-oriented, modern enterprise.

About the role :

As a Salesforce Architect at SailPoint, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our enterprise architecture, ensuring our CRM architecture aligns perfectly with global standards and business objectives.

In this role, your typical day will involve leading the design, implementation, and optimization of our Salesforce ecosystem, which includes Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CPQ.

You will act as the technical anchor, translating complex business needs into scalable, secure, and high-quality technical architectures.

You will write and review Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC), design integrations and APIs, and work collaboratively with global stakeholders to unlock the maximum potential of our Salesforce platform.

About the team :

You will join our high-performing Enterprise Applications and Business IT team.

This global team of dedicated developers, administrators, and business analysts is committed to driving operational excellence across SailPoint's core systems.

We collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to design and build automated, efficient enterprise workflows.

We operate in an agile environment that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, providing you with a supportive network to deliver high-impact results.

Requirements :

- Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- Minimum of 13 years of experience on the Salesforce platform, with a proven track record in solution design and architecture.

- Strong, hands-on knowledge of Salesforce configurations, Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC).

- Proven experience with Salesforce integrations, APIs, and enterprise-grade third-party integration tools.

- Deep familiarity with multiple Salesforce clouds, specifically Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CPQ.

- Active Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect credentials.

Preferred Skills :

- Active Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification.

- Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts.

- Knowledge of SailPoint's identity security products and how they integrate with Salesforce.

- Strong experience working within Agile development methodologies and modern DevOps pipelines.

- Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with global stakeholders.

Roadmap for success :

1. First 30 days :

- Master the technical stack by completing a deep-dive review of our Salesforce ecosystem (Sales, Service, CPQ) and existing integrations to understand operational workflows.

- Align with Product Owners and business stakeholders to map out strategic project roadmaps and backlog priorities for the upcoming quarters.

- Learn and adopt internal DevOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, release management protocols, and environment strategies.

- Establish collaborative working patterns by conducting introductory meetings and technical syncs with developers, administrators, and business analysts.

2. By 60 days :

- Partner with business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce architectural designs.

3. 6 months :

- Lead and deliver at least one high-impact, strategic Salesforce architectural initiative from conception to successful production deployment.

- Optimize system performance by identifying, diagnosing, and resolving platform bottlenecks, reducing technical debt by 15% across core modules.

- Design and implement at least two reusable integration frameworks or API patterns to streamline data flow between Salesforce and downstream business applications.

- Establish long-term system health monitoring configurations and DevOps enhancements to support automated testing and environment alignment.

4. By 1 year :

- Own the overall Salesforce architecture roadmap, aligning platform capabilities with SailPoint's long-term business and enterprise systems goals.

- Foster a proactive engineering culture by implementing intelligent automation patterns to reduce manual development or operational tasks.

- Audit and modernize data management strategies, including the optimization of data modeling, data sharing rules, and archiving processes.

- Conduct architectural reviews for all major platform enhancements, ensuring 100% compliance with security, scalability, and enterprise standards.

- Drive solution quality by performing regular code reviews of Apex and LWC, advocating for development best practices, and mentoring junior developers on architectural guardrails.

- Facilitate sprint delivery by collaborating with the Scrum team to resolve technical impediments, refine technical user stories, and ensure predictable releases.

About SailPoint India and our Benefits :

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence.

Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security.

With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.

Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2 - 3 days a week (unless otherwise specified).

We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits :

- Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees.

- All premiums are paid by SailPoint.

- Company sponsored health-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents.

- Annual performance bonus.

- Restricted stock units at certain levels.

- 24 Leaves every year in addition, 10 holidays.

- Flexible Work hours.

title: VP Technology/Head of Engineering
description:
About Pepagora Empowering SMEs for a Smarter Tomorrow

Pepagora is more than a marketplace; it's a movement. We're redefining how Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) connect, trade, and grow in today's digital economy.

At our core, Pepagora is an AI-powered B2B platform designed to build trust, transparency, and growth in business transactions. Your Mission :

You'll be responsible for defining and executing our tech strategy, building scalable systems, driving innovation through AI, and cultivating a strong engineering culture. This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution to shape the future of our platform.

Technology Leadership & Strategy :

- Ensure every tech initiative aligns with business strategy, customer needs, and global digital trends.

- Architect a resilient, high-performance platform that scales with user growth and global expansion.

- Optimize AI-driven matchmaking, fraud detection, and predictive analytics.

- Lead the way in DevOps, CI/CD, microservices, and seamless platform integrations.

Cybersecurity & Compliance :

- Create a fortress of trust: secure user data, enable safe transactions, and comply with global privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

- Build a tech ecosystem where security and transparency are baked into every layer.

AI Innovation & Data Intelligence :

- Turn data into growth by leveraging AI to generate actionable insights, recommendations, and real-time decision-making tools for SMEs.

- Build responsible AI systems with robust data governance and user privacy at their core.

Team Leadership & Culture :

- Build, lead, and mentor a world-class engineering team that thrives on innovation and purpose.

- Foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning.

- Serve as a bridge between product, business, and engineering to deliver value fast.

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Expansion :

- Forge strong alliances with global tech players, AI labs, payment providers, and government bodies.

- Drive platform integrations across logistics, fintech, and B2B services.

Who You Are :

The Essentials :

- 10+ years of hands-on technology leadership experience in high-growth SaaS, marketplaces, or AI-powered platforms.

- Proven success scaling secure, data-rich platforms handling millions of users or transactions.

Expertise in :

- AI/ML (TensorFlow, PyTorch, NLP, real-time analytics)

- Cloud computing (AWS/GCP/Azure)

- DevOps, microservices, Kubernetes, API security

- Programming in Python, Java, Golang, or Node.js

Bonus Points :

- Experience with blockchain, smart contracts, and digital trust frameworks.

- A deep passion for solving real-world problems for SMEs.

Why Join Pepagora?

Considering your next big move? Here's why Pepagora could be the right choice for yousimple, clear, and meaningful:

1. Transform SMEs Worldwide :

- Pepagora is creating a powerful digital ecosystem designed specifically for SMEs.

- Our platform provides AI-driven business matchmaking, verified transactions, and essential digital tools like marketing, finance, and global trade all in one place.

- We're leveling the playing field, giving small and medium businesses access to the digital capabilities usually reserved for large enterprises.

2. Massive Market, Unlimited Opportunity :

- SMEs represent over 90% of businesses globally, driving substantial economic growth and employment.

- The global SME digital transformation market is rapidly expanding and expected to reach hundreds of billions in value within the next few years.

- Joining Pepagora places you at the forefront of capturing this immense growth opportunity.

3. Founded on Deep Experience :

- Led by Murugesan Dhanapal, who brings over 25 years of dedicated experience empowering SMEs globally.

- His vision is grounded in real-world insights, genuine passion, and an unwavering commitment to positively impact business owners, their families, and communities.

4. Early-Stage Momentum with Global Potential :

- Pepagora is already active, funded, and validated across India, GCC, and emerging markets.

- Youll join at a crucial moment, directly influencing critical decisions and the future trajectory of the platform.

5. Ownership and Legacy :

- Experience true autonomy your ideas and actions will directly shape our global growth.

- You'll build something meaningful, creating lasting change and a legacy you can proudly stand behind.

6. Real Impact Beyond Numbers :

- Your work will help millions of SMEs grow digitally, reach global markets, and significantly impact local economies.

- The success of Pepagora is measured not just in business metrics but in real-world outcomes: jobs created, communities strengthened, and lives improved.

If you've ever thought :

I want my work to matter. I want to help build something that truly makes a difference.

This is Pepagora.

title: Manager / Senior Manager, Technical Operations
description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with neffy®, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Manager / Sr. Manager, Technical Operations will play a key role in executing Technical Operations programs that support the continued development and commercial supply of neffy™. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment, project management, and external partner leadership in a highly collaborative environment.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and CMOs, this role provides technical and operational leadership across the ARS outsourced manufacturing network. Responsibilities include leading Technical Operations projects, supporting formulation and process development, technology transfer, GMP manufacturing activities, and resolution of technical and operational issues. The position ensures project scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, and budgets remain aligned while proactively identifying and escalating risks to support compliant, reliable, and on-time product supply.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage cross-functional Technical Operations projects and day-to-day technical and operational interactions with assigned external partners, including scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, budgets, risks, key milestones, project meetings, action tracking, scopes of work, proposals, change orders, and CMO/vendor performance metrics and KPIs (e.g., service, quality, delivery, capacity, and right-first-time).
  • Serve as a Technical Operations point of contact for assigned external manufacturing partners and work closely with CMOs and internal stakeholders to ensure execution against agreed project plans and supply requirements.
  • Provide technical oversight of formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process characterization, process validation/PPQ, and continued process verification activities, as applicable.
  • Plan and support clinical and commercial manufacturing campaigns in coordination with CMOs, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, and other internal functions; provide on-site/person-in-plant support for key manufacturing activities as needed.
  • Review manufacturing and process documentation, including master and executed batch records, protocols, reports, process performance data, vendor change controls, investigations, and annual/product reviews, for technical accuracy and process performance.
  • Lead or support technical assessment and resolution of manufacturing deviations, out-of-specification or atypical results, and other process issues; contribute to root-cause analysis and appropriate corrective and preventive actions in partnership with Quality Assurance.
  • Assess proposed manufacturing and process changes for technical impact and support cross-functional evaluation of quality, supply, and regulatory implications.
  • Monitor and trend manufacturing and process performance data to identify emerging risks, process drift, and opportunities for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Support vendor selection, onboarding, and qualification activities in collaboration with Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate project status, technical risks, manufacturing issues, and recommend actions clearly to Technical Operations leadership and cross-functional stakeholders; escalate significant issues to appropriate decision-makers.
  • Support preparation and review of CMC information for regulatory submissions and responses to health authority questions, as required.
  • Support Technical Operations process improvement, business continuity, capacity planning, and other strategic operational initiatives as assigned.
  • Support commercial supply operations managed within Technical Operations, including coordination with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, distribution partners, and external manufacturing/packaging partners to maintain reliable product supply.
  • Support product serialization activities, including EPCIS data exchange and operational compliance with applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements, working with packaging, distribution, Quality Assurance, and other partners as appropriate.
  • Support clinical supply activities, including coordination with Clinical Operations and external vendors for clinical packaging, labeling, distribution, inventory/expiry management, and Interactive Response Technology/Interactive Web Response System (IRT/IWRS) activities, as applicable.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong working knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), pharmaceutical manufacturing operations, and applicable quality systems and regulatory expectations.
  • Demonstrated technical understanding of formulation, manufacturing processes, scale-up, technology transfer, process validation, and process performance sufficient to critically evaluate CMO data and recommendations, work effectively in cross-functional technical teams, and hold external partners accountable to commitments.
  • Strong project and vendor management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, deliverables, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex manufacturing or process issues, develop recommendations, and communicate the rationale for action.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively across functions and organizational levels, including senior management and external partners.
  • Well-organized, detail-oriented, and able to identify and escalate risks while maintaining focus on execution and business priorities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project/reporting tools; experience with project management, continuous improvement, or operational excellence methodologies is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of commercial and clinical supply operations relevant to Technical Operations, including 3PL interfaces, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA requirements, and clinical IRT/IWRS processes; direct experience in one or more of these areas is preferred.
  • Must be able to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 20% to support external manufacturing partners and key project activities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering, engineering, or a related scientific/technical discipline; an advanced degree is a plus. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience in Technical Operations, manufacturing, process/formulation development, CMC, supply chain, or a related function.
  • Experience working with external CMOs/CDMOs and supporting GMP clinical and/or commercial manufacturing is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with drug-device combination products, nasal/inhalation products, sterile manufacturing, commercial product launch, or PPQ is preferred.
  • Experience reviewing manufacturing batch records and process documentation and supporting technical investigations, change controls, and regulatory CMC activities is preferred.
  • Experience supporting commercial distribution/3PL operations, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and/or clinical supply and IRT/IWRS activities is preferred.
At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.
The full-time salary range for this posted position is $140,000 to $175,000 and may be eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus. Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

This position is also eligible for Equity, 401k matching, and our excellent benefits package including 100% employer paid Medical, Dental & Vision for employees. View the full package here: ARS Careers Page

ARS Pharmaceuticals is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals so that an individual can perform their job-related duties. If you are interested in applying for an employment opportunity and require special assistance or an accommodation to apply due to a disability, please contact us at careers@ars-pharma.com

title: Senior AI Infrastructure/AI Platform Engineer
description:
Senior AI Platform Engineer

The Role :

We are hiring a Senior AI Platform Engineer to build the platform layer that operationalizes core AI systems.

This role is centered on R&D-to-platform rollout: taking technically sophisticated model systems and making them usable, reliable, and scalable inside the product stack. You will work across model pipelines, training systems, inference infrastructure, distributed execution, and backend platform architecture.

This is not a thin integration role. It requires strong engineering depth and enough model understanding to work effectively with systems involving fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (RL), alignment, interpretability, agent execution, and inference optimization across LLMs, agents, and tabular foundation models.

Responsibilities :

- Own the platformization of internal AI libraries, turning research-heavy systems into robust platform capabilities with stable APIs, execution layers, observability, and deployment paths.

- Build and scale training and post-training infrastructure for workflows including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), evaluation, model adaptation, and agent optimization.

- Design the integration layer between research systems and product infrastructure, including job orchestration, artifact management, dataset versioning, experiment lineage, and runtime control surfaces.

- Build inference systems that support complex model behaviors under production constraints, including latency, throughput, cost efficiency, debuggability, and safety.

- Design for multi-cluster and distributed execution, including scheduling, fault tolerance, checkpointing, retries, workload isolation, and heterogeneous compute environments.

- Operationalize internal fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, interpretability, tracing, and behavioral inspection systems into production-ready platform capabilities.

- Build common platform primitives for model lifecycle management across training, evaluation, serving, rollback, and monitoring.

- Partner closely with research teams to translate model-science complexity into production architecture without sacrificing technical rigor.

- Improve platform reliability for long-running and failure-prone AI workloads, especially where model behavior, system behavior, and infrastructure behavior interact in complex ways.

- Ensure alignment, interpretability, and auditability are embedded into system design, particularly for enterprise and regulated deployments where model outputs and decisions must be explainable.

Example Problems You Might Work On :

- Turn internal fine-tuning and reinforcement learning frameworks into production-grade services supporting multiple model families, datasets, and evaluation loops.

- Build rollout infrastructure for new model-science capabilities so research systems can be safely and incrementally exposed inside the platform.

- Integrate model tracing and interpretability capabilities into training and inference pipelines to enable debugging and behavioral inspection.

- Build inference architecture for large language models and agent systems that balance cost, performance, explainability, and runtime control.

- Design distributed execution flows across clusters for long-running training, evaluation, and analysis workloads with strong guarantees around recovery and reproducibility.

- Unify workflows across LLMs, agents, and tabular models without forcing a one-size-fits-all abstraction.

- Build platform interfaces that allow downstream teams to launch, inspect, evaluate, and deploy complex model workflows without rebuilding research infrastructure.

Requirements :

- Strong experience building and shipping complex AI/ML systems in production.

- Deep backend and platform engineering experience, especially in Python, distributed services, workflow orchestration, data systems, and cloud infrastructure.

- Hands-on experience with one or more of :

1. Fine-tuning systems

2. Reinforcement learning pipelines

3. Inference infrastructure

4. Distributed training

5. Model serving

6. Evaluation systems

- Strong understanding of the systems implications of modern model workflows across LLMs, agents, and structured/tabular foundation models.

- Experience scaling workloads across clusters and production environments with strong instincts around reliability, observability, and performance.

- Ability to work across research code, systems code, and product infrastructure without losing rigor at either layer.

- Strong technical judgment around trade-offs between model quality, infrastructure complexity, scalability, interpretability, and operational cost.

Strong Bonus Signals :

- Experience with alignment, interpretability, or AI safety systems.

- Experience with multi-cluster scheduling, inference optimization, or serving infrastructure for large models.

- Experience converting internal research frameworks into reusable platform capabilities.

- Experience debugging production failures caused by interactions between model behavior, orchestration systems, and infrastructure.

- Experience with agent runtimes, tool orchestration, long-horizon execution, or stateful model systems.

What This Role Is Not :

- Not a prompt engineering role.

- Not a glue-code integration role.

- Not a research-only role disconnected from deployment.

- Not a junior role.

This role is for engineers who want to work at the intersection of model science, platform architecture, and production systems, building the infrastructure that enables advanced AI capabilities to operate reliably at scale.

Role Overview :


We are looking for a passionate and highly skilled Applied Data Scientist - Credit Risk with a strong foundation in machine learning, statistical modelling, and real-world problem solving within the BFSI and lending domain.


The ideal candidate will have 4- 7 years of hands-on experience in building, fine-tuning, and deploying end-to-end data science solutions, ranging from traditional risk scorecards to advanced machine learning models. Model Development & Research :

- Performance Benchmarking : Benchmark and continuously improve model performance using appropriate evaluation metrics and experimentation frameworks.

Data Handling & Feature Engineering :

- Large-Scale Data Processing : Work with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets to build robust data pipelines, conduct exploratory data analysis, and engineer high-quality features.

- Data Quality Assurance : Ensure rigorous data preprocessing, augmentation, and validation to maximize model accuracy and generalization.

Algorithm Design & Optimisation :

- Production Optimization : Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable algorithms optimised for production environments.

- Model Explainability : Ensure risk algorithms conform to high standards of transparency, interpretability, and statistical soundness.

Cross-Team Collaboration :

- Business Alignment : Partner closely with product, engineering, and business teams to align AI/ML solutions with organizational goals.

- Scoping Requirements : Translate ambiguous business and portfolio problems into well-scoped data science problem statements with clear success criteria.

Research & Innovation :

- Continuous Learning : Stay current with state-of-the-art advancements in machine learning.

- Methodology Adoption : Evaluate and adopt relevant new techniques into the team's workflow.

- Knowledge Sharing : Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and, where applicable, to external publications, technical blogs, or patents.

Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing :

- Team Guidance : Mentor junior data scientists and ML engineers, providing guidance on modelling approaches, code quality, and production readiness.

Education Qualifications :

- Bachelor's or Master's degree from a premier institution in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

Experience :

- 4- 7 years of professional experience in applied data science, machine learning engineering, or risk analytics specifically within the BFSI and lending domain.

- Proven track record of developing credit risk scorecards, behavioral models, and regulatory frameworks (BASEL-2 / IFRS9 / ECL / PD / LGD).

- Demonstrated experience implementing supervised machine learning techniques and unsupervised learning techniques (e.g., PCA, K-means customer clustering).

- Strong understanding of statistical fundamentals and neural network fundamentals.

- Generative AI : Experience or familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.

- Deep Learning : Hands-on experience applying deep learning techniques to financial services or credit risk use cases.

- Advanced LLM Frameworks : Familiarity with prompt engineering, RLHF, and LLM evaluation frameworks.

- Governance : Contributions to open-source ML projects, published research, or active participation in responsible AI and strict model governance practices within regulated industries.

Technical Skills :

- Data Engineering : SQL, pandas, Spark / PySpark for large-scale data processing.

- ML Frameworks & Libraries : Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch.

- Core Modeling Techniques : Supervised Machine Learning (Logistic Regression, GLM, XGBoost), Unsupervised Machine Learning (PCA, K-means customer clustering).

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer / Senior Engineer

Department : Product & Engineering

Location : Noida, India

Work setting : Work from office (WFO)

Purpose of the Job :

Doceree is building the first proactive intelligence layer for pharma brand teams - an agentic AI system that turns clinical intent signals, campaign data, and market context into a daily brief that drives a decision in under five minutes. We are hiring AI Engineers to build the systems behind that surface. You will design and ship production AI systems - LLM-powered pipelines, agentic workflows, retrieval over heterogeneous healthcare data, evaluation harnesses, and the orchestration layer that sits between our signal foundation and the brand managers morning brief.


You will work closely with data scientists, product, and platform engineering to take prototypes from a notebook to something a brand team relies on everyday. You will thrive here if you enjoy living at the seam between LLMs, traditional ML, and well-engineered backend systems - and if you care about making AI useful, reliable, and measurably better in a regulated, real-world domain.

Key Responsibilities :

- Design, build, and ship production-grade LLM and agentic AI systems powering anomaly detection, contextual synthesis, next-best-action recommendations, and one-click activation across the Daily Command product surface.

- Build robust retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over Docerees clinical intent signals, campaign data, market data, and partner data - including chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and grounding strategies.

- Implement agent orchestration patterns (tool use, planning, multi-step reasoning, structured outputs, guardrails) using modern frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LlamaIndex, custom orchestration) and own the latency, cost, and reliability of those agents end-to-end.

- Build evaluation and observability for AI features - offline eval sets, golden datasets, LLM-as-judge harnesses, regression tests, online metrics, prompt/version tracking, and trace inspection.

- Engineer prompts, system instructions, and tool interfaces as first-class artifacts - versioned, tested, and tied to measurable business outcomes (lift, NBRx correlation, decision time, action acceptance rate).

- Integrate and benchmark multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source via vLLM/TGI), and make pragmatic build-vs-buy and model-routing decisions based on quality, latency, and unit economics.

- Partner with data scientists to productionize ML models (classification, ranking, recommendation, embedding, forecasting) - wrapping them in services, pipelines, and APIs that downstream agents and product surfaces can consume.

- Own scalable, cloud-native deployment of AI services on AWS, with strong MLOps/LLMOps hygiene: CI/CD for models and prompts, feature/vector stores, monitoring, drift detection, cost guardrails, and safe rollout.

- Implement safety, privacy, and compliance controls appropriate for healthcare/HCP data - PII/PHI handling, prompt injection defenses, output validation, auditability, and human-in-the-loop where it matters.

- Collaborate with product and design to translate fuzzy user problems into well-scoped AI subsystems, then prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and harden the winner.

- Stay current with advances in LLMs, agents, retrieval, evaluation, and inference infrastructure, and bring back whats genuinely useful.

Qualifications - Experience, Skills & Education :

- B.Tech / M.Tech / Ph.D. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or related quantitative discipline from a Tier 1/2 institution.

- 2- 8 years of experience building and shipping AI/ML systems in production, with at least 2+ years focused on LLM-based or agentic AI applications (RAG, tool-using agents, copilots, structured generation, evaluation).

- Strong programming fundamentals in Python, with solid software engineering practices (typing, testing, code review, modular design, performance awareness). Comfortable in SQL and working with cloud-native data systems.

- Hands-on experience with one or more LLM/agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Haystack, Semantic Kernel, or well-reasoned custom stacks) and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, FAISS, etc.).

- Practical experience with prompt engineering, structured outputs (JSON schemas / function calling), tool use, and evaluation - including building your own eval harnesses rather than relying solely on vendor dashboards.

- Working knowledge of classical ML/DL libraries (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, SpaCy, NumPy, Pandas) and when not to reach for an LLM.

- Experience deploying services on AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, SageMaker, Bedrock) and familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or equivalents).

- Demonstrated ability to operate on noisy, incomplete, and sensitive real-world data, and to design systems that fail safely, observably, and recoverably.

- Strong product instincts - you can push back on a half-formed requirement, scope an MVP, and know when "good enough to ship and learn" beats "perfect on a benchmark".

- Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain agent behavior, eval results, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and to write design docs the rest of the team will actually read.

Preferred Qualifications :

- Experience building multi-agent or workflow-based AI systems (planner/executor patterns, critic/verifier loops, long-running agents with state).

- Familiarity with inference optimization - quantization, batching, KV cache reuse, speculative decoding, serving with vLLM/TGI/Triton, or building latency/cost-aware model routers.

- Solid grounding in the math behind ML and LLMs - linear algebra, probability, statistics, and a working understanding of how transformers and embeddings actually behave.

Education :

- UG : Any Graduate

- PG : Any Postgraduate
