title: Computer Vision Manager
description:
Overview about Ripik.AI :

Ripik.ai is an Accel-backed Applied AI company building computer vision and process-optimization agents for the world's largest industrial enterprises across steel, cement, aluminum, chemicals, pharma, and power. Our Vision AI platform acts as an automated pair of eyes on the shop floor monitoring materials, equipment, and processes 24/7 with 95%+ accuracy, eliminating human error, and delivering measurable gains in throughput, yield, energy efficiency, and safety.

We work with marquee customers including Tata Steel, JSW, ArcelorMittal, Vedanta, Godrej & Boyce, Grasim, Holcim, and Jindal Steel, and are scaling globally across India, the Middle East, Europe, and North America. As we move into our next phase of growth, we are building the operating backbone that will take Ripik from a high-velocity scale-up to a category-defining global industrial AI company.

The Role :

We are looking for a hands-on Data Science Manager to lead a team of 6 to 8 AI - Computer Vision engineers. This is a player-coach role : you will set technical direction, personally solve the hardest modelling problems, and grow a high-performing engineering team all within the fast-moving environment of a venture-backed industrial AI start-up. Prior formal management experience is not required; what matters is deep technical expertise, the ability to influence through craft, and the drive to build and ship in ambiguous, high-stakes settings.

Key Responsibilities :

1. Technical Leadership & Hands-on Delivery :

- Own the end-to-end computer vision roadmap from problem framing and data strategy through model development, edge deployment, and production monitoring across Ripiks industrial portfolio (steel, cement, pharma, paints, and beyond).

- Personally architect and build solutions for the most complex vision challenges : novel defect types, extreme class imbalance, multi-camera fusion, low-light / high-noise factory environments, and real-time inference on constrained edge hardware.

- Stay at the cutting edge of CV research and rapidly evaluate and adopt new models and techniques YOLO26, SAM 3, Vision Transformers (DINOv2, Swin), Grounding DINO, RF-DETR, zero-shot / open-vocabulary detection (YOLO-World, CLIP) translating papers into production value.

- Define and enforce engineering standards for the vision stack : model training pipelines, data versioning (DVC), annotation workflows (CVAT, Roboflow, Label Studio), experiment tracking (W&B, MLflow), edge export formats (TensorRT, ONNX, OpenVINO), and CI/CD for model updates.

- Drive inference optimisation quantisation (INT8 / FP16, GPTQ), pruning, knowledge distillation, and batching strategies to meet latency and cost targets across NVIDIA Jetson, industrial PCs, and cloud GPU instances.

2. Team Building & People Growth :

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 68 Computer Vision engineers set clear goals, run structured code reviews and design reviews, and create an environment of rapid learning and ownership.

- Hire and onboard strong engineers; raise the technical bar through hands-on pairing, knowledge-sharing sessions, and a culture of experimentation over perfection.

- Manage sprint planning, task prioritisation, and delivery timelines; balance exploratory R&D with committed product deliverables in a fast-paced start-up cadence.

- Act as the primary technical interface between the CV team and cross-functional stakeholders product, field engineering, operations, and leadership translating business problems into well-scoped modelling projects and communicating results clearly.

3. Innovation & Problem Solving :

- Identify and frame novel, first-of-its-kind vision problems in industrial settings where off-the-shelf approaches fall short; design creative solutions combining classical image processing, deep learning, and domain heuristics.

- Champion a data-centric AI approach invest in annotation quality, active learning, synthetic data generation, and feedback loops from production rather than only chasing bigger models.

- Establish robust evaluation frameworks : domain-specific metrics, A/B testing against production baselines, and systematic failure-mode analysis to ensure models deliver real business impact.

Required Skills & Experience :

- Bachelors or Masters degree (or PhD) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

- 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in computer vision with a strong track record of taking models from research / prototyping through to production deployment.

- Deep proficiency in Python and PyTorch; strong working knowledge of OpenCV, Albumentations, and image / video processing fundamentals.

- Demonstrated expertise across multiple CV tasks : object detection, instance / semantic / panoptic segmentation, anomaly detection, pose estimation, or tracking.

- Hands-on experience with modern model families YOLO (v8 / v11 / v26), transformer-based detectors (RT-DETR, DETR, RF-DETR), segmentation models (SAM / SAM 2), and CNN backbones (ResNet, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, Vision Transformers).

- Production experience deploying models to edge or on-prem hardware using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or OpenVINO; comfort with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one cloud platform (AWS / Azure / GCP).

- Experience in a high-growth start-up or similarly fast-paced environment where scope is ambiguous, timelines are tight, and wearing multiple hats is the norm.

- Strong first-principles problem-solving ability comfortable navigating novel, unstructured problems where no playbook exists.

- Excellent communication skills able to distil complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, write clear documentation, and present results to leadership and customers.

Good to Have :

- Prior experience leading or mentoring a small engineering team (formal management title not required; tech-lead, senior IC, or project-lead experience counts).

- Experience with industrial or manufacturing domains understanding of factory-floor constraints, camera setups, lighting variability, and integration with PLCs / SCADA systems.

- Familiarity with zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection (Grounding DINO, YOLO-World, CLIP) and foundation models (DINOv2, SAM 3, Florence) for data-efficient learning.

- Exposure to visionlanguage models (GPT-4o vision, Gemini, LLaVA) for combining visual inspection with natural-language reporting or operator copilots. Knowledge of 3D vision, depth estimation, point-cloud processing, or multi-camera calibration for volumetric industrial inspection.

- Experience with multi-object tracking (ByteTrack, BoT-SORT) and video analytics pipelines for continuous production-line monitoring.

- Contributions to open-source CV projects, publications in top-tier venues (CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, NeurIPS), or strong Kaggle competition results.

What Can You Expect?

- A leadership seat at a high-growth, venture-backed AI start-up directly shape the technical direction and team culture of the computer vision function.

- Ability to shape the future of manufacturing by leveraging best-in-class AI and software; develop a niche skill set at the intersection of deep learning and heavy industry.

- World-class work culture, coaching, and development.

- Mentoring from highly experienced leadership from world-class companies (refer to Ripik.AI website for details).

- International exposure.

description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart’s Borrower Experience team builds the experiences that help borrowers manage their loans from funding through final repayment. As part of Servicing, the team owns borrower-facing web and mobile experiences, including the Funded Borrower Dashboard, payment journeys, and Sierra, our servicing AI agent. Our mission is to make managing a loan simple, transparent, and empathetic—helping borrowers make payments, find support, and stay on track.

Our work directly influences borrower trust, payment success, operational efficiency, and Upstart’s financial performance. We partner closely with Product, Design, Operations, Analytics, and Compliance to turn complex servicing needs into intuitive products backed by reliable, scalable systems.

As the Senior Engineering Manager, Borrower Experience, you will lead a team of fullstack engineers with ownership across user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and integrations. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will shape technical strategy, develop a high-performing team, and deliver borrower-facing products that balance usability, delivery speed, reliability, and compliance. You will also help modernize our servicing architecture, creating foundations that make it easier to build and improve borrower experiences.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of fullstack engineers delivering borrower-facing web and mobile experiences.
  • Own technical execution across the stack, connecting intuitive user interfaces with reliable backend services, APIs, and servicing systems.
  • Partner with Product and Design to improve the Funded Borrower Dashboard, payment journeys, and AI-powered support experiences.
  • Define and execute a multi-quarter technical strategy that advances borrower experience and Servicing priorities.
  • Guide architectural decisions and modernization efforts that improve system reliability, observability, maintainability, and development speed.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to simplify complex borrower needs and regulatory requirements into clear, accessible product experiences.
  • Build a culture of ownership, product quality, experimentation, and operational excellence, with clear visibility into priorities, delivery risks, and trade-offs.

  • 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including 4–7 years in engineering management.
  • Experience leading fullstack engineering teams that build and operate customer-facing products.
  • Strong technical depth across frontend architecture, backend services, APIs, distributed systems, and system design.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with Product and Design to deliver intuitive user experiences and measurable business outcomes.
  • Proven experience leading teams in regulated domains such as fintech, payments, or lending.
  • Experience defining and delivering complex technical strategies while balancing product delivery with architectural improvements.
  • A strong track record of hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing engineers.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to varied audiences.

Time zone requirements The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Senior AI Engineer at Fourkites

At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. The FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.

As a Senior AI Engineer on the Appointment Manager and Alan teams, you will work at the frontier of agentic AI and live operational supply chain software. Appointment Manager is a mature, business-critical inward scheduling platform - enabling FourKites and our clients internal teams to manage and optimize appointment workflows. Alan is an outward-facing AI agent that brings intelligent, agentic appointment scheduling directly to our clients - about a year old, built on Pipedream, and rapidly gaining traction. LangGraph adoption is planned as the next evolution of our agentic architecture across both products.

This is a full-stack ownership role - you own the entire SDLC from requirements to release, with no dedicated QA, operating in a Kanban flow augmented by AI agents (FAST, QA Agent, repo-level subagents, Claude Code) at every stage. Grooming is async and lightweight - the PM leverages agents to write features, stories, and acceptance criteria. The approach is deliver first, improve next. You are not just a consumer of AI tooling - you actively shape how these agents get smarter.

What you'll be doing :

- Design and implement agentic workflows in Appointment Manager and Alan; drive LangGraph adoption as it is introduced into the stack

- Write and manage test cases in TestRail; implement and maintain automation suites

- Own release management, regression, and sanity testing end-to-end

- Manage PagerDuty on-call responsibilities for a live operational product

- Operate as man-in-the-loop across AI agent tooling (FAST, QA Agent, repo subagents, Claude Code) at every stage of delivery

- Actively contribute to the stability, accuracy, and capability improvement of internal AI agents

About the team :

Appointment Manager is a mature, business-critical inward scheduling platform - enabling FourKites and our clients internal teams to manage and optimize appointment workflows at scale. Any bug or defect has immediate real-world impact on our clients supply chain operations. In Facilities engineering, bugs are treated one priority higher than other products.

Alan is an outward-facing AI agent that brings intelligent, agentic appointment scheduling directly to our clients - automating and orchestrating scheduling workflows on their behalf. About a year old and rapidly gaining traction, Alan is deeply workflow-driven, built on Pipedream, and growing rapidly. LangGraph adoption is planned across both AM and Alan as the next evolution of our agentic architecture.


The team operates on Kanban - continuous flow, no sprint ceremonies, work pulled not pushed. Grooming is async and lightweight - the PM uses agents to write features, stories, and ACs; engineers consume, clarify, and deliver. The approach is deliver first, improve next. Every engineer owns the full delivery lifecycle : design, implementation, QA, test automation, release management, and on-call. AI agents (FAST, QA Agent, repo-level subagents, Claude Code) augment every stage of the SDLC. We are aggressively pushing the boundary of what AI-augmented software delivery looks like, and we want you to be a central part of that.

Who you are :

- Hands-on experience with LangGraph - this is non-negotiable

- Proven experience deploying and operating AI agents in production environments

- Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide developers and senior developers - through code reviews, design discussions, and day-to-day collaboration

- Comfortable being a technical reference point for peers and cross-team engineers on agentic systems and workflow architecture

Who we are :

FourKites, the leader in AI-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites Intelligent Control Tower breaks down enterprise silos by creating a real-time digital twin of orders, shipments, inventory and assets. This comprehensive view, combined with AI-powered digital workers, enables companies to prevent disruptions, automate routine tasks and optimize performance across their supply chain. FourKites processes over 3.2 million supply chain events daily - from purchase orders to final delivery - helping 1,600-plus global brands prevent disruptions, make faster decisions and move from reactive tracking to proactive supply chain orchestration. title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Artificial Intelligence
description:
Opportunity :

The Forward Deployed AI Engineer is the person who closes that gap. You embed (virtually) with strategic customer accounts, understand how their support and operations teams actually work, and then build production-grade configurations, automations, knowledge pipelines, and integrations that make Hivers AI deliver measurable outcomes in their environment. You stay until it works, and you carry what you learn back into the product.

This is an engineering role, not a sales role. No quota, no commission, no demo circuit. Your success metric is whether the customers AI deployment is live, trusted, and adopted.

Key Responsibilities :

What are we looking for :

- 4 to 6 years as a software engineer, with at least 1 to 2 years working hands-on with LLM-powered systems in production : prompt and context engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, eval harnesses.

- Strong Python; comfortable with TypeScript/JavaScript for full-stack work (dashboards, integrations, internal tools).

- Real API/integration experience youve connected messy third-party systems before and know that the documented behaviour and the actual behaviour are different things.

- Excellent written and verbal communication. You can run a discovery call with a non-technical support manager, explain a misclassification to a skeptical ops lead without jargon, and write a deployment doc someone else can follow.

- High ownership and comfort with ambiguity. There is no playbook for most of what youll do youll write the playbook.

- Comfortable with the 3 PM 12 AM IST schedule this role lives in the customers working day, so afternoon-to-midnight hours are the job, not an occasional ask.

What you will do :

- Embed with strategic accounts. Join shared Slack channels, sit in on the customers team rituals, shadow real ticket queues, and map how work actually flows through their shared inboxes all remotely.

- Build the last mile. Design and ship customer-specific AI configurations : Playbook automations, KB ingestion and chunking strategies, triage and tagging taxonomies, custom integrations against the customers stack via APIs and webhooks.

- Own deployments end-to-end. From discovery through go-live through stabilisation.

- When the customers automation misfires on a Tuesday morning, youre the one who diagnoses it, fixes it, and explains what happened in language their ops lead understands.

- Make AI trustworthy account-by-account. Build per-account golden datasets, run evals against the customers real traffic patterns, and gate rollouts on measured quality the same eval-first discipline we apply to products, applied to deployments.

- Be the products field intelligence. Every gap you hand-build is a roadmap signal.

- Youll work closely with the AI product and engineering teams to turn repeated custom work into product capabilities, and youll write up deployment patterns so the next account is faster than the last.

- Drive adoption, not just go-live. Partner with CSMs on activation : train champion users, instrument usage, and iterate until the customers team reaches for the AI features by default.

Nice to have :

- Experience at a B2B SaaS company in a solutions, implementation, or platform engineering capacity.

- Familiarity with customer support / CX tooling (helpdesks, shared inboxes, ticketing systems).

- Exposure to LLM observability and eval tooling (Langfuse, LLM-as-judge patterns, golden datasets).

- Prior experience as a founder, early-stage employee, or consultant anything that taught you to scope ambiguous problems with limited support.

What this role is not :

- Not a sales engineer role. You enter after the deal (or late in it, for technical validation on strategic accounts). You dont carry a quota.

- Not a support escalation role. You build; you dont run a ticket queue.

- Not a travel role. Embedding happens through the customers Slack, their Hiver workspace, and recurring working sessions.

Why this role matters :

Hiver is moving from AI features to AI outcomes. The companies winning in AI-first SaaS from Palantir to OpenAI to Databricks learnt the same lesson : the hardest part of AI isnt the model; its making it work inside a real organisation's messy reality. This role is how we do that for our most important customers and how what we learn there shapes the product for everyone else.

title: Clinical: Clinical Supervisor - Per Diem (Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, and Staten Island.
location: New York City, NY, United States
description:
Per Diem RN Clinical Supervisor – New York City, NY

All Metro Health Care | A Modivcare Personal Care Service

Location: New York City, NY
Office: 75 Broad Street, Suite 610, New York, NY 10004
Employment Type: Per Diem | Field-Based
Schedule: Flexible, Visit-Based | Early Morning & Evening Availability Required
Service Territory: Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn & Staten Island
Pay: $60–$180 per visit, depending on visit type
Mileage Reimbursement: Provided at the current federal rate for eligible travel

About the Opportunity

All Metro Health Care, a Modivcare Personal Care Service, is seeking an experienced Per Diem RN Clinical Supervisor to support our home care operations throughout New York City.
This field-based opportunity is ideal for a Registered Nurse with direct experience in a New York State Licensed Home Care Services Agency (LHCSA) who understands home health aide supervision, home care regulations, and clinical documentation requirements.
In this role, you'll primarily conduct in-home supervisory visits to ensure Home Health Aides (HHAs) provide safe, appropriate care in accordance with established plans of care and applicable home care requirements.

You'll also support nursing assessments, reassessments, and additional clinical visits as needed.

We're looking for an RN who can work independently, has hands-on home care supervisory experience, and offers flexible availability for early-morning and evening visits across assigned NYC boroughs.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct in-home supervisory visits while assigned Home Health Aides are providing patient care.
  • Observe and evaluate caregiver performance, patient safety, and adherence to established plans of care.
  • Provide clinical guidance, education, and corrective instruction to HHAs as needed.
  • Conduct initial nursing assessments, reassessments, and post-hospitalization visits as assigned.
  • Review and update individualized plans of care in collaboration with the clinical team.
  • Identify and communicate changes in patient conditions, caregiver performance, or service needs.
  • Coordinate with branch staff and clinical management to ensure timely supervisory coverage.
  • Provide additional field support when regularly assigned nurses are unavailable.
  • Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation in accordance with agency policies and applicable New York State home care regulations.
  • Support continuity of care through effective communication with patients, caregivers, and clinical leadership.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted New York State Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing.
  • Professional RN experience with direct exposure to LHCSA home care operations and supervisory responsibilities.
  • Experience conducting in-home HHA supervisory visits and evaluating caregiver performance.
  • Working knowledge of home care regulations, care plans, and clinical documentation requirements.
  • Current CPR certification.
  • Strong clinical assessment, communication, organizational, and patient education skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage field assignments with minimal supervision.
  • Ability and willingness to travel across assigned NYC service territories.
  • ​​​​​​​Availability to conduct supervisory visits during early-morning hours (approximately 7:30 AM) and evening hours (after 8:00 PM), based on patient and caregiver schedules.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience conducting initial nursing assessments, reassessments, and post-hospitalization visits within a LHCSA.
  • Familiarity with HHAeXchange or similar home care documentation systems.
  • Experience providing caregiver education, competency evaluations, and clinical follow-up.
  • ​​​​​​​Flexibility to accept additional assignments across multiple NYC boroughs as operational needs arise.

Schedule & Service Area

  • Employment Type: Per Diem | Field-Based
  • Primary Service Areas: Manhattan, Bronx, and Brooklyn
  • Additional Coverage: Staten Island, as needed
  • Office Location: Manhattan, NY
  • Schedule: Flexible, visit-based assignments based on patient needs and operational coverage.
  • Early-Morning Availability: Supervisory visits may be scheduled around 7:30 AM.
  • Evening Availability: Supervisory visits may be scheduled after 8:00 PM.
  • Additional Visits: Occasional daytime or weekend assignments may be available based on operational needs.
  • ​​​​​​​Geographic Flexibility: Nurses must be comfortable accepting assignments across designated NYC boroughs when additional coverage is needed.

Important Scheduling Information

Many of our patients receive home care services through caregiver shifts operating from approximately 8:00 AM–8:00 PM and 8:00 PM–8:00 AM.
Supervisory visits must be coordinated while the assigned Home Health Aide is present and providing care. As a result, early-morning and evening availability is particularly important.

This is not a traditional weekday daytime nursing position. Visit assignments, schedules, and volume may vary based on patient needs and operational demand. A fixed number of weekly visits is not guaranteed.

Per Diem Compensation

Earn $60–$180 per visit, depending on visit type, plus mileage reimbursement.

  • Supervisory & Post-Hospital Visits: $60
  • Reassessment Visits: $90
  • Initial Admission Assessments: $120 weekdays | $180 weekends

Mileage Reimbursement: Provided at the current federal rate for eligible travel.

This is a per diem, visit-based position. Visit assignments and earnings vary based on patient needs and the types of visits completed.

Why Join All Metro Health Care?

  • Flexible, per diem scheduling.
  • Opportunity to work independently in a community-based setting.
  • Meaningful patient and caregiver relationships.
  • Support from an established home care team.
  • Mileage reimbursement for eligible travel.
  • ​​​​​​​Opportunity to use your clinical expertise to support quality patient care.

Our Mission
To provide access to the care that matters for those who need it most.

Our Values

Caring: We care about what we do and who we do it for.
Collaborative: We value the perspective and experience of all.
Dedicated: We are committed to making a real-world impact.
Purposeful: We know our work has meaning.

Physical Requirements: The physical demands described are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. Frequent standing and walking; assisting patients; operating medical equipment; bending, reaching, positioning; occasional patient transfers or lifting; exposure to healthcare environments.

Join Our Team
If you're a Registered Nurse looking for a flexible, community-based opportunity where you can use your clinical experience to support patients and caregivers, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to learn more about our Per Diem RN Clinical Supervisor opportunity in New York City!

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer - Artificial Intelligence
description:
About Guidewire:

Guidewire Software is the platform trusted by 540+ P&C insurers across 40+ countries to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently.

We combine Digital, Core, Analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. With 1600+ successful implementations and the largest R&D team in the industry, we are transforming how insurers operate globally.

- Design & build cloud-native data platforms

- Deliver mission-critical insights for insurers

- Build secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS services

- Drive innovation using AI and modern engineering practices

You will play a pivotal role in building next-generation analytics SaaS services that power Guidewire's industry-leading cloud platform.

About the Job :

Summary :

Join Guidewire as a Machine Learning Platform Engineer and play a pivotal role in architecting and scaling our next-generation ML platform.


You will drive the design and implementation of secure, cloud-native infrastructure supporting the full ML lifecycle, from data ingestion to model monitoring.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, reliable, and efficient solutions that empower our customers and accelerate Guidewire's AI and data platform adoption.

At Guidewire, you'll help deliver measurable value and efficiency for customers by advancing operational excellence and transformative innovation.


Our Product Development & Operations (PDO) priorities focus on secure, scalable platform operations, accelerating AI and cloud adoption, and ensuring every customer is successful and referenceable.


You'll contribute to a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and responsible AI, supporting Guidewire's mission to transform the global P&C insurance industry through technology and data-driven insights.

What You'll Do :

- Design and implement core ML infrastructure for model training, hyperparameter tuning, experiment tracking, and model registry, using cloud-native and open-source technologies.

- Contribute to evolving a scalable, secure ML platform that supports the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

- Orchestrate ML workflows using tools such as Kubeflow, SageMaker, MLflow, Vertex AI, or Databricks, ensuring reproducibility and robust automation.

- Partner with Data Engineers to build reliable, high-quality data pipelines and feature pipelines that provide model-ready datasets at scale.

- Implement and improve CI/CD for ML, including automated testing, validation, and safe rollout/rollback of models and data pipelines.

- Optimize ML workload performance and cost across compute, storage, and networking layers on public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

- Embed observability and governance into the platform, including logging, tracing, model performance monitoring, and drift detection.

- Collaborate with security, compliance, and data governance teams to ensure the platform adheres to Guidewire's standards for security, privacy, and auditability.

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers, influencing architectural decisions, coding standards, and best practices for ML platform and MLOps.

- Continuously explore and apply AI/automation (including GenAI) to improve developer and data scientist productivity, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.

What You'll Bring :

- Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and use data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement in your current role.

- Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2-3+ years working on ML platforms or infrastructure.

- Expertise in building large-scale distributed systems and microservices, with solid understanding of system design and architecture.

- Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or Java, with emphasis on writing clean, testable, maintainable code.

- Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration, for example Docker and Kubernetes.

- Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker and how they fit into an end-to-end ML platform.

- Cloud platform experience on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including core services for compute, storage, networking, and identity.

- Experience with statistical learning algorithms (e.g., GLM, XGBoost, Random Forest) and deep learning approaches (e.g., neural networks, transformers), with a practical understanding of how they are trained and deployed.

- Strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence across functions and work effectively in a global, distributed environment.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Engineering Manager AI/ML Platform to lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-scale AI/ML platforms and Generative AI solutions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software engineering, cloud-native architectures, MLOps, and machine learning systems, coupled with proven leadership experience managing high-performing engineering teams.

This role requires driving strategic AI initiatives, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, MLOps automation, and scalable platform engineering while collaborating closely with Product, Data Science, Architecture, and Business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities :

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI/ML engineers, platform engineers, and software developers.

- Define engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural guidelines.

- Conduct technical reviews, performance evaluations, and career development planning.

- Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

- Drive Agile development processes and ensure timely delivery of business-critical initiatives.

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable AI/ML platforms supporting model development, training, deployment, and monitoring.

- Build reusable frameworks and platform capabilities for machine learning lifecycle management.

- Establish standardized workflows for model experimentation, validation, deployment, and governance.

- Develop enterprise-grade solutions supporting predictive analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI use cases.

- Lead implementation of GenAI applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs).

- Design and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for enterprise knowledge systems.

- Build AI Agent architectures using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar technologies.

- Optimize prompt engineering, model orchestration, and inference performance.

- Evaluate and integrate foundation models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google, and open-source ecosystems.

- Implement MLOps best practices for continuous training, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

- Build automated ML pipelines using MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, or equivalent platforms.

- Establish model versioning, experiment tracking, feature management, and governance frameworks.

- Implement monitoring solutions for model drift, performance degradation, and operational reliability.

- Ensure reproducibility and scalability of machine learning workloads.

- Design cloud-native architectures on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

- Develop containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.

- Build scalable microservices-based systems supporting AI/ML workloads.

- Implement event-driven architectures leveraging Kafka and messaging platforms.

- Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, security, and performance optimization.

- Partner with Product Managers to define AI product roadmaps and technical strategies.

- Collaborate with Data Scientists to operationalize machine learning models.

- Work closely with Enterprise Architects to align platform capabilities with organizational objectives.

- Present technical solutions and platform strategies to senior leadership and stakeholders.

- Drive adoption of AI/ML best practices across engineering teams.

Required Skills & Technical Expertise :

1. Programming Languages :

- Strong proficiency in Python and Java.

- Experience with REST APIs and backend application development.

2. Generative AI & Machine Learning :

- Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI (GenAI), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, LangChain / LangGraph, AI Agents, Fine-tuning and model optimization, and Vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, FAISS).

3. MLOps & ML Platforms :

- MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Model Monitoring, Experiment Tracking, Feature Stores, and CI/CD for ML workflows.

4. Cloud Technologies :

- AWS (SageMaker, EKS, Lambda, Bedrock), Microsoft Azure (Azure ML, AKS, OpenAI Services), and Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, GKE).

5. Containerization & Orchestration :

- Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Container Security.

6. Streaming & Messaging :

- Apache Kafka, Event-driven Architecture, and Message Queues.

7. DevOps & Automation :

- CI/CD Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred).

8. Databases :

- PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Vector Databases.

Qualifications :

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.

- 9- 15 years of overall software engineering experience.

- 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams.

- Strong experience building enterprise AI/ML platforms and cloud-native applications.

- Proven expertise in MLOps, Generative AI, and Large Language Model-based solutions.

- Experience delivering scalable, production-grade machine learning systems.

- Strong understanding of distributed systems and microservices architecture.

- Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or similar foundation models.

- Exposure to AI governance, Responsible AI, and model compliance frameworks.

- Experience in enterprise AI transformation initiatives.

- Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP) preferred.

- Implement and evaluate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for secure, context-aware querying

- Work on LLM integration layer : prompt engineering, guardrails, output validation, and data mitigation strategies

- Establish evaluation frameworks : accuracy, bias detection, privacy leakage metrics, and model drift monitoring

LLMs & Applied NLP :

- Strong understanding of Encoder models (BERT, RoBERTa, DeBERTa)

- Strong understanding of Decoder models (GPT family, LLaMA, Mistral)

- Deep knowledge of Transformer architecture attention mechanisms, positional encoding, k-v caching, tokenization strategies

- Familiarity with Dense, Convolutional, Sequence model layers (LSTMs, GRUs)

- Hands-on experience with LLM fine-tuning : LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, instruction tuning

- Prompt engineering : few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output enforcement

- Named Entity Recognition (NER) : custom entity models for PII (names, addresses, financial data, health records)

- Text classification, sentiment analysis, and zero-shot/few-shot classification (e.g., DistilBART-MNLI)

- Familiarity with embedding models and vector similarity search (FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB)

Agents & Orchestration :

- Experience building AI Agents : tool-calling agents, ReAct pattern, plan-and-execute architectures

- Familiarity with agent frameworks : LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent

- Understanding of multi-agent systems : agent communication, task delegation, state management

- RAG pipeline design : chunking strategies, retrieval ranking, context window management

Qualifications :

- B.Tech/M.Tech/MS in Computer Science, AI/ML, Mathematics, or related field

- 3 to 5 years of professional experience building and deploying ML models in production

- Published or demonstrable work with transformer-based architectures

- Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, probability, statistics, and optimization

Why Join Us?

- Work at the intersection of AI, privacy, and compliance, shaping global standards.

- Be part of an award-winning startup making an impact worldwide.

- Take ownership and drive innovation in Responsible AI & Privacy Tech.

About PrivaSapien :

Privacy Engineering and Responsible AI are critical for building ethical AI guardrails. At PrivaSapien, we are pioneering a comprehensive suite of Privacy Engineering and Responsible AI products to govern data and AI the right way.

Recognized globally, we have won multiple awards, including :

- Morgan Stanleys "Future of AI" Award

We serve large enterprises across India, the Middle East, Europe, and the US and have filed 25 patents. Our team is deeply research-driven, with 40% of our talent recruited from IISc & ISI Kolkata.

Join us in shaping the future of AI with privacy at its core.

Our Vision & Work Culture :

- At PrivaSapien, we believe privacy is a fundamental right in the digital age. Without it, human thoughts, emotions, and even decisions can be manipulatedturning individuals into "AlgoSlaves." Our mission is to build privacy engineering & Responsible AI solutions that safeguard digital experiences while creating strategic advantages for businesses.

2. Passion : Crazy Enough to Change the World

- We dont follow trends; we create them. Every PrivaSapien is empowered to innovate in their role, redefining privacy and Responsible AI for the world.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Chief Technology Officer

Tribeca Developers - Mumbai - Full-time, on-site

The Role :

This is a rare opportunity to architect that technology platform from the ground up. We are looking for a hands-on Chief Technology Officer to own and build Tribeca's technology and AI platform end to end. This is a builder's CTO role, not a figurehead. You will define the architecture, write and review code, make the build-versus-buy calls, and recruit and lead a dedicated technology team over time.


You will report directly to the Founder and CEO and sit on the leadership team. The mandate is to turn a traditional, document-and-spreadsheet-driven real estate business into an AI-native operating platform : custom internal tools for sales, construction, finance, design, and business development; an intelligence layer that sits across the company's data; and the connective infrastructure that makes it all work together.

What You'll Own :

- Architect Tribeca's core technology platform from first principles data layer, application layer, AI/intelligence layer, and integrations.

- Lead the build of custom, AI-native internal tools (CRM, construction project management, finance automation, marketing and BD tooling) where off-the-shelf software is overkill or a poor fit.

- Design and own the AI strategy : where large language models, agents, and automation create genuine operating leverage, and how to deploy them responsibly and cost-effectively.

- Make the build-versus-buy decisions across the stack, and defend them on total cost of ownership, not just sticker price.

- Recruit, hire, and lead a technology team of engineers and AI specialists in the coming time as we develop and grow.

- Establish engineering standards, security and access controls, and data governance suitable for a company preparing for public-market scrutiny.

- Partner directly with the Founder and functional heads to diagnose where technology should intervene and where it shouldn't.

Who You Are :

- A genuine builder. You have personally architected and shipped production software and AI systems, and you can still get into the code. You lead from the front, not from slideware.

- AI-native. You have hands-on depth with modern AI large language models, RAG, agentic systems, MCP, prompt and context engineering - and strong judgment about what is real versus hype.

- Architecturally disciplined. You match the solution to the size of the problem. You optimize for total cost of ownership and operational resilience, and you know when a simple system beats a clever one.

- A leader and recruiter. You have built and led engineering teams, and you can attract strong talent to a non-obvious industry.

- Commercially fluent. You can sit with a finance, sales, or construction head, understand their P&L and workflow, and design technology that moves the business - not just technology for its own sake.

Background We Value :

- 8+ years in technology, with meaningful time as a senior technical leader, head of engineering, or CTO.

- A track record of building digital products in a data-rich, consumer-facing or financial domain - fintech, wealthtech, proptech, e-commerce, or similar.

- Direct experience building AI-powered products in the current generation of tooling.

- Exposure to real estate, construction, or the home-building process is a strong plus. Domain understanding of how a developer actually operates - timelines, collections, approvals, sales cycles - meaningfully shortens the ramp.

- A strong engineering foundation from a top institution (IITs, BITS, NITs, or international equivalent), or a track record that speaks louder than the credential.

Why This Role :

- Build the technology backbone of a market-leading, pre-IPO company from the ground up - with a clean slate and a founder who wants it built right.

- Direct access to and partnership with the Founder/CEO; a seat at the leadership table.

- The chance to be the architect of what may be India's first AI-native real estate developer - a genuinely differentiated story.

- Competitive compensation with meaningful equity participation in a company heading toward a public listing.

Location : Mumbai, Head Office - Lower Parel

About Tribeca :

Tribeca Developers is India's largest luxury branded-residential developer and the world's largest developer of Trump-branded residences, operating an asset-light model across Mumbai, Pune, NCR, and Hyderabad. We are building toward a public listing and are investing heavily in becoming India's first genuinely AI-native real estate developer.

title: Sr. Manager Total Rewards

Sagent is transforming the mortgage servicing industry by bringing the modern experience customers now expect from loan originations to loan servicing. title: Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture
description:
Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture

Remote – Western US (Pacific or Mountain time zone preferred)

Why Us

NewRocket is a ServiceNow Elite Partner and a Claude Select partner, helping enterprises reimagine how work gets done with ServiceNow and AI. We work with public and private sector organizations, including some of the world’s biggest brands, to simplify processes, remove complexity, and turn the promise of AI into measurable business outcomes. We are “Raising the Bar” in delivering technology’s promise to create new kinds of experiences for our customers.

Our Core Values: Excellence, Creativity, Integrity, Teamwork and Empathy #ExCITE. At NewRocket, these values guide everything we do: they are the foundation of our culture and define how we Go Beyond for our clients.

The Role

About the role

We're hiring a Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture to be the technical leader on our client engagements, working alongside our forward deployed engineers as they build and deploy agentic AI inside complex enterprise environments. This is a billable, client-facing consulting role.

Large enterprises don't run on one system. They run on decades of layered platforms: ERP backbones like SAP and Oracle, service and workflow platforms like ServiceNow, CRM, HR and finance suites, custom integrations, data warehouses, and the identity and security controls that hold it all together. Agentic AI only creates value when it can work safely inside that landscape: reading the right data, taking the right actions, respecting approvals and access controls, and leaving an audit trail that satisfies IT, security and compliance.

On each engagement, you're the person who understands that landscape. You map the client's systems, translate their business goals into the architecture and requirements agents need, and lead the forward deployed engineers through it as they build, so workflows make it out of pilot and into the client's production environment.

What you'll do

  • Lead engagements technically. Serve as the senior technical leader on client engagements, setting architecture direction and guiding the forward deployed engineers who are building alongside you.
  • Map the client's system landscape. Quickly get to grips with each client's environment, including ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, custom systems and the integrations between them, and turn it into a clear picture the engineering team can build against.
  • Translate business processes into agent-ready requirements. Work with client process owners to break down workflows like incident resolution, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and employee onboarding into the tasks, data, decisions, permissions and human approval points an agent must handle.
  • Design how agents connect to systems of record. Define the integration approach for each engagement: APIs, integration platforms, event streams, MCP and tool-calling layers, and data access patterns.
  • Get workflows into production. Navigate the client's environments, change management, release processes, testing, monitoring and support handoff so agentic workflows move from pilot to production.
  • Clear the path with security and governance. Design identity and access models for agents (service accounts, least privilege, delegated authority), audit logging and controls, and win sign-off from client CISOs, risk teams and auditors.
  • Advise senior client stakeholders. Act as a trusted architecture advisor to client CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects and platform owners, and identify where agentic workflows can expand into new use cases.
  • Strengthen the practice. Turn what you learn on engagements into reusable blueprints, integration playbooks and readiness assessments, and share field insight with our product and engineering teams.

What you bring

  • 7 to 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture or technical leadership roles within large, complex enterprise software environments.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of at least two major enterprise platforms, such as ServiceNow, SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), Oracle (Fusion, E-Business Suite, OCI), Salesforce or Workday, including their data models, APIs, extension frameworks and upgrade constraints.
  • Strong grounding in enterprise integration: REST and SOAP APIs, middleware and iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP Integration Suite or similar), event-driven architecture, and master data management.
  • Practical experience with AI or automation in production, such as LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, RPA or intelligent automation, and a clear point of view on where agents fit and where they don't.
  • Proven track record moving enterprise systems from design to production, including environment management, SDLC and change control, testing, monitoring and operational support.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise security and governance: identity and access management, SSO and OAuth, role-based access, audit, and regulatory requirements such as SOX, GDPR or HIPAA.
  • Client-facing consulting experience, such as at a Big Four firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG), Accenture or another global systems integrator or enterprise software vendor's professional services team, including working in a billable delivery model and advising executive stakeholders in plain business terms.
  • Experience serving as technical lead for engineering teams on delivery engagements, guiding engineers who are building while staying hands-on enough to unblock them.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Location and travel

  • You must live in the Western United States, in the Mountain or Pacific time zone.
  • You must be willing to travel up to 75% to client sites.

Nice to have

  • Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, or platform certifications (ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect, SAP or Oracle architect certifications).
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use and function calling, retrieval-augmented generation and agent evaluation methods.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks).
  • Experience working alongside forward deployed engineering teams, or in a similar embedded delivery model.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, public sector or manufacturing.
  • Public thought leadership: talks, writing or published reference architectures on enterprise AI.

What success looks like

This is a billable, client-facing consulting role. You'll be embedded on customer engagements alongside our forward deployed engineers, serving as the architecture lead who helps the team navigate complex enterprise system landscapes.

  1. Engagement delivery: You consistently meet billable utilization targets and are the go-to architect on our most complex client engagements.
  2. Landscape mastery for the team: On each engagement, you quickly map the client's system landscape (ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle and the integrations between them) and give forward deployed engineers a clear path through it: where the data lives, which APIs and controls apply, and who owns what.
  3. Production outcomes: Agentic workflows you architect reach the client's production environment, with sign-off from their IT, security and risk teams.
  4. Client trust: Clients see you as a senior advisor, leading to engagement extensions, expanded scope and referenceable outcomes.
  5. Repeatable delivery: Patterns, integration playbooks and readiness assessments from your engagements are reused across the practice, making each new deployment faster.

About the Role :

We are looking for a talented Machine Learning & LLM Engineer to work on a high-impact initiative at the intersection of traditional predictive modeling and modern Large Language Models (LLMs).

Your primary mission is to transform an existing knowledge and competitor intelligence agent into a product winner prediction enginea system capable of assessing product specifications such as color, fabric, sleeve type, category, and price point to predict whether a product is likely to be a commercial winner or non-winner.

This role requires strong expertise in both classical Machine Learning and hands-on LLM engineering. You will work with real product and assortment data, design prediction workflows, and build intelligent pipelines that turn product attributes into actionable commercial insights.

What You Will Do :

- Lead the transformation of an existing knowledge/competitor-oriented agent into a product winner prediction agent by redesigning its core intelligence layer from retrieval and lookup to predictive scoring.

- Design and build ML prediction pipelines that take structured product inputs (color, fabric, sleeve type, category, price point, etc.) and generate winner/non-winner classifications with confidence scores.

- Develop and optimize LLM-integrated workflows where natural language product descriptions, buyer briefs, or specification sheets are parsed, enriched, and fed into predictive models.

- Build user-facing workflows that allow business users to enter product specifications through structured or conversational interfaces and receive ranked predictions with explanations.

- Work with assortment and product performance datasets to build, validate, and continuously improve supervised and semi-supervised predictive models.

- Engineer feature extraction pipelines from product attributes, including :

1. Color

2. Fabric

3. Construction

4. Seasonal trends

5. Historical sell-through rates

6. Competitor signals

- Collaborate with product and data teams to define winner/non-winner labeling strategies and identify business metrics such as :

1. Sell-through rate

2. Margin

3. Reorder rate

- Evaluate, benchmark, and improve model performance through offline evaluation frameworks and production feedback loops.

- Document model architecture, data lineage, and prediction logic to support governance, explainability, and stakeholder trust.

Required Skills & Experience :

1. Machine Learning :

- Strong hands-on ML background.

- Classification and regression modeling.

- Ensemble methods :

a. XGBoost

b. LightGBM

c. Random Forest

- Feature engineering.

- Model evaluation and production deployment.

2. LLM Engineering :

- Practical experience integrating LLMs into production workflows.

- Prompt engineering.

- Function/Tool calling.

- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.

- Output parsing.

- LLM evaluation.

3. Predictive Product / Outcome Modeling :

- Strong Python skills.

- Experience with :

a. Pandas

b. NumPy

c. Scikit-learn

- Ability to clean, wrangle, and engineer features from product catalog and transactional datasets.

5. ML Pipeline & Deployment :

- Experience building and deploying end-to-end ML pipelines including :

a. Training

b. Evaluation

c. Versioning

d. Inference serving

Preferred Skills & Experience :

- Text embeddings, multimodal embeddings, similarity search, and product clustering.

- MLflow, Weights & Biases, experiment tracking, model registry, and performance monitoring.

- Experience building agentic pipelines where LLMs orchestrate tool calls, data lookups, and model inference workflows.

title: Industrialization Engineer
location: Mountain View, CA, USA; Novi, MI, USA
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

You will:

  • Supplier Assembly Line Deployment: Lead the industrialization of "build to print" automotive autonomous sensors & ECUs (cameras, radars, lidars, compute) at external supplier partner facilities. Oversee the design, installation, and validation of automated and semi-automated assembly lines. Track production line readiness (PCBA and FATP) for all NPI builds and early production builds. Drive the resolution of open technical questions from external suppliers.
  • Process Engineering & Quality: Ensure supplier manufacturing processes strictly adhere to engineering drawings, tolerances, and automotive quality standards. Drive the completion of DFxs, PFMEAs, Control Plans, MSA and capability studies (Cp/Cpk). Enforce structured equipment/station development with FMEA approach. Support ILQC audits and drive implementation of Preventative & Detective controls at external suppliers.
  • Program Management: Act as the primary technical project manager for supplier launches. Establish realistic timelines, track milestones, manage equipment buy-offs (FAT/SAT), and ensure flawless execution through PPAP and Start of Production (SOP). Coordinate material supply to ensure the manufacturing development schedule stays on track. Ensure CMs have the latest BOMs and corresponding component specifications. Drive the mitigation of all process development / qualification risks that pose a threat to meeting the product performance and quality requirements.
  • Contract & Commercial Management: Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to develop Statements of Work (SOW), technical specifications, and equipment contracts. Negotiate technical terms, manage change orders, and hold suppliers accountable to contractual obligations. Track suppliers Capex spend.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the technical liaison between Internal R&D, Quality, Purchasing, and External manufacturing partners. Coordinate with Waymo cross-functional technical teams for support in debugging & resolving issues that impact manufacturing line qualification. Ensure compliance to defined requirements and manage any changes proposed by Waymo or external suppliers. Provide clear updates to Waymo management on the manufacturing process & test development & qualification status.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify manufacturing bottlenecks, yield issues, and cycle time constraints on supplier lines. Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to optimize production efficiency and product quality. Identify key learnings from past projects and ensure target action items are fully executed. Ensure all proposed product or component changes are properly evaluated and appropriately implemented while mitigating associated risks for the production / equipment processes.

You have:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in process or manufacturing engineering within the automotive industry, with direct experience handling automotive sensors, ECUs or complex electronic assemblies.
  • Technical Skills: Deep understanding of "build to print" manufacturing models, automated assembly processes, testing/calibration of sensors, and automotive core tools (APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, SPC, MSA).
  • Supplier Management: Proven ability to drive Tier 1/Tier 2 suppliers and equipment integrators to meet strict launch deadlines and quality metrics.
  • Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience reviewing, negotiating, and executing technical contracts, SOWs, and capital equipment agreements.
  • Program Management: Strong project management skills. PMP certification is a strong plus.

We prefer:

  • Advanced Manufacturing Experience: Hands-on experience with automation, active alignment (AA) of optical lenses, precision automated adhesive/TIM dispensing, UV curing, wire bonding, or cleanroom manufacturing (ISO Class 5-7).
  • Specialized Testing Knowledge: Familiarity with end-of-line (EOL) functional testing for ECUs, optical target rooms for cameras/LiDAR, or RF testing in anechoic chambers for radar.
  • Certifications: Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
  • Software Proficiency: Experience using statistical analysis software (e.g., Minitab, JMP) to analyze supplier yield data, and basic proficiency in CAD (e.g., CATIA, SolidWorks) to review engineering prints and supplier DFM feedback.
  • Industry Standards: Deep working knowledge of TS16949, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) and ASPICE, specifically how they dictate manufacturing traceability, serialization, and line-side controls.

Travel requirements:

  • 30% to travel domestically and internationally to supplier manufacturing sites as required during critical launch phases.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range
$230,000—$284,000 USD

title: Senior Director / Executive Director, Forecasting & New Product Planning
description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with neffy®, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

JOB SUMMARY:

Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, the Sr. Director/Executive Director, Forecasting & Commercial Assessments is the company’s authoritative source for commercial projections and strategic market analytics. This leader owns the corporate forecast for neffy, leads commercial assessments for neffy lifecycle opportunities and future pipeline and business development assets, and directs the Market Insights and Competitive Intelligence function through an experienced Senior Director.

The role is a strategic analytical partner to the CCO and the executive leadership team. It turns market data, performance trends, and forward-looking assumptions into the commercial story the company presents to its Board of Directors and the investment community.

This is a high-visibility role for a leader who can build a rigorous, defensible model, leading to a clear, confident point of view for senior executives, investors and the Board. Success depends on close collaboration with Marketing, Sales, Market Access, Commercial Operations, Trade/Channel, Finance, Medical Affairs, Investor Relations and Business Development, and will be demonstrated through the actions and deliverables below.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Forecasting & Commercial Assessment

  • Own the corporate demand forecast for neffy; the number used for the operating plan, S&OP, and external guidance, including scenario and sensitivity analysis
  • Provide the forecast foundation that Commercial Operations uses for quota setting, incentive compensation design, and territory-level planning
  • Track actual performance against forecast and lead variance analysis. Define leading indicators such as prescription trends, new-to-brand and refill behavior, and gross-to-net, and recalibrate assumptions as the market develops.
  • Assist with commercial assessments for pipeline opportunities and business development targets, covering addressable patient population, pricing and access assumptions, peak sales, and risk-adjusted value
  • Support diligence on in-licensing and M&A opportunities with rapid, decision-grade analysis

Market insights & Competitive Intelligence

  • Lead the Market Insights and CI function through the Senior Director, setting the research agenda, priorities and budget to align with forecasting, brand planning and leadership decision needs.
  • Ensure primary research directly informs forecast assumptions and strategic choices, including demand studies, ATU tracking, conjoint and pricing research, and HCP, patient, caregiver and payer research
  • Oversee competitive monitoring, scenario planning and war-gaming to anticipate competitor actions and market shifts and prepare the organization to respond

Board and Investor Narrative

  • Serve as the analytical lead behind Board materials, earnings preparation, guidance discussions and investor events, keeping the external narrative consistent with the internal forecast
  • Work with the CFO and Investor Relations to prepare data-backed responses to investor and analyst questions. Monitor sell-side consensus models and explain where and why company views differ
  • Translate complex analyses into clear, executive-ready visuals and messages that make the commercial story easy to follow

Cross-Functional Partnership and Team Leadership

  • Act as a trusted colleague and thought partner to commercial leaders and promote data driven decision-making across the organization.
  • Maintain a single, aligned view of the market and forecast so that leadership, the Board and investors all receive consistent numbers.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or related discipline required; MBA/advanced degree preferred. Equivalent combination of education and relevant job experience may be considered
  • 15+ years of related experience, with a minimum of 8 years in Life Sciences - biotechnology, pharmaceuticals or a related field
  • Prior experience and expert knowledge within commercial disciplines such as forecasting/analytics, product strategy, new product planning, market research, pricing, or strategic marketing
  • Demonstrated experience providing key commercial insights, pipeline planning & forecasting, and leading the insights function to relate scientific information & market intelligence into commercial recommendations
  • Experience successfully partnering across the organization to align and move efforts forward
  • Demonstrated experience in presenting complex data, strategies, and concepts to key stakeholders/executive team/Board

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including the ability to evaluate forecasts, market models and commercial scenarios
  • Solid understanding of pharmaceutical development and end-to-end commercialization
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects/teams, and collaborate well and influence without direct authority
  • Strong judgment in situations involving ambiguity or incomplete information
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills with the ability to communicate clear, decision-oriented recommendations
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operating style suited to a fast-paced biotechnology environment
  • Collaborative, influential, and excellent people skills
  • Ability to travel up to 30% is required for success in the role

LEVELING SENIOR DIRECTOR/EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR:
The role will be leveled based on the candidate’s experience, scope of prior leadership, and readiness to operate independently with the Board and investors, as determined by ARS. Both levels own the same core responsibilities; the Executive Director level carries greater autonomy, external exposure and enterprise influence.

title: Manager, Operations - Day Shift
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

The Manager, Operations coordinates and oversees the day-to-day management of a distribution department. Additionally, they perform other related duties, special projects, or assignments as required.

  • Collaborate with IT as a user for systems development and refinement to enhance operations, productivity, and service levels.
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills You Will Need

Analytical and Problem-Solving: Continuously analyze work processes, identifying optimization opportunities and implementing improvements. Review analyses of activities, costs, operations, and forecast data to assess department progress toward goals.

Communication and Interpersonal: Conduct presentations to retail division and senior management with strong written and oral communication skills. Demonstrate interpersonal competencies, including integrity, trust, adaptability, motivation ability, coaching, mentoring skills, and initiative. Who You Are

  • Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply.
  • This position requires heavy lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands. Requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around the facility or department, lifting at least 50 lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders. May involve reaching above eye level. Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including days, evenings, weekends, holidays.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Annual merit review

  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!
