title: Staff Hardware Systems Engineer
description:
About Gather AI

Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery.

If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.

About the role

We're hiring a Staff Hardware Systems Engineer to own requirements, integration and verification and validation (V&V) for our warehouse robotics hardware: autonomous inventory drones, forklift-mounted vision systems, and the charging and battery systems that support them. You'll make sure every Gather hardware product is built from testable requirements, de-risked one technology block at a time, integrated cleanly with firmware, software and autonomy, and released on objective evidence that holds up in real warehouses.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small, senior hardware team in Pittsburgh. You'll set up the framework and do the work yourself: scout and test new technologies, write the requirements, build the test rigs, run the tests and analyze the data.

What you'll do

  • Own the requirements and V&V framework for our hardware products, from system requirements down to subsystem, technology-block and interface requirements, with traceability to verification evidence.
  • Scout, characterize and compare candidate technologies (cameras, illumination, propulsion, wireless charging, batteries and more), and recommend which to take into the next product.
  • Own integration of electrical, firmware, software and autonomy into the hardware product design, including bring-up, integration testing and root cause of interface failures.
  • Write and run V&V plans: test methods, rigs, fixtures and instrumentation; statistically based sampling plans; design of experiments; clear conclusions with stated uncertainty.
  • Own environmental and compliance testing (shock and vibration, thermal and condensation, ingress, EMC/FCC), working with external test labs.
  • Own technical budgets (power, thermal, mass, EMC/RF), lead system-level hazard analysis, and feed DFMEA.
  • Deliver decision-ready evidence for design reviews, design freeze and release, and assess the verification impact of engineering changes.
  • Close the loop from field failures back to requirements and tests, and shape production test strategy with our contract manufacturer.

What success looks like

  • 30 days: Own verification for our next-generation forklift vision system and break its system requirements down to hardware level.
  • 60 days: Define requirements and the V&V plan for a new charging system, and get the requirements cascade and verification matrix in use on a live product line.
  • 90 days: Requirements cascade and verification matrix in use across active product lines; test plans for current technology blocks; a reusable library of environmental test profiles.
  • 1 year: V&V evidence built into every hardware stage gate, next-generation products released against that standard, and a production test coverage proposal handed to manufacturing.

What you bring

  • You've owned requirements through V&V on an electromechanical product taken from concept to production: decomposing product requirements to subsystem level with traceability, and writing and running V&V plans with objective, measurable acceptance criteria.
  • You've integrated hardware with firmware and software in a robotic, embedded, autonomous or complex electromechanical system, including bring-up and root-causing interface failures.
  • You use statistics to make engineering decisions: design of experiments, data analysis and statistically based sampling plans (confidence/reliability, AQL or similar).
  • You build the test, not just the plan: test methods, rigs, fixtures and data acquisition, including measurement system analysis (e.g., Gauge R&R).
  • BS in an engineering field with 10+ years of relevant experience, or an MS (preferred) with 8+ years.

Nice to have

  • Environmental and compliance qualification with external labs: shock and vibration, thermal cycling and condensation, IP ingress, EMC/FCC.
  • Vision and power technology: camera characterization and illumination, lithium batteries and charging systems, and trade studies to choose between them.
  • Regulated product development (medical, aerospace, automotive), with the judgment to scale that rigor to a startup.
  • Experience with drones/UAVs, material handling equipment or robotics.

Location

Pittsburgh, PA. On-site 4–5 days a week (this is a lab-heavy, hands-on role), with about 10% travel to test labs, our contract manufacturer and customer warehouses.

title: Mission Engineer II - Grand Rapids
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable. As a Mission Engineer II, you'll work directly alongside public safety agencies to turn real operational challenges into working technical solutions.

You'll spend time with the people doing the work, understand how the agency operates, identify problems worth solving, and use Axon tools, AI, automation, data, and the broader Axon ecosystem to build against them.

Building is the core of the role, but customer needs come first. Because you're embedded with the agency, you'll also become a go-to technical resource who understands their Axon environment and helps them navigate critical needs when they arise. You may help quarterback an upcoming deployment, coordinate a complex technical issue, or connect the right Axon teams around an agency priority.

You won't replace Support, Deployment, Product, or other teams. You'll bring technical continuity, help connect the dots, and use what you learn to identify the next opportunity to build something better. Mission Engineers don't measure success by activity. They measure it by what gets built, what gets used, and what changes because of it.

What You’ll Do

Location: On Site with travel
Reports To: Manager or Senior Manager of Mission Engineering

Discover the Mission

  • Embed with assigned agencies to understand their mission, people, workflows, systems, and priorities.
  • Develop broad knowledge of the Axon ecosystem and deeper expertise in the products deployed at your agency.
  • Work with frontline users, technical teams, and agency leadership to uncover operational friction.
  • Translate customer problems into clear technical requirements and measurable success criteria.
  • Identify opportunities for AI, automation, data, and Axon capabilities to improve how the agency operates.
  • Understand what the customer needs—not simply what they initially ask for.

Build With the Platform

  • Build applications, dashboards, workflows, automations, and using Axon products and other approved Axon tools.
  • Apply foundational software engineering concepts including APIs, data structures, scripting, testing, debugging, and version control.
  • Use AI and AI-assisted development tools responsibly within Axon's approved development and security environment.
  • Configure and extend capabilities across Axon's technology ecosystem.
  • Understand when you can solve the problem yourself and when deeper Product or Engineering partnership is required.
  • Build with Axon—not around it.

Transform Builds Into Outcomes

  • Move solutions from discovery into real customer use.
  • Test and iterate alongside the people who will actually use what you build.
  • Drive adoption and measure results against agreed success criteria.
  • Continue improving solutions until they create sustained operational value.
  • Document successful solutions so they can be maintained, improved, and reused.

Be the Agency's Go-To Technical Resource

  • Maintain a consistent onsite presence and deep understanding of the agency's Axon environment.
  • Lean into critical customer needs when your technical context or involvement can materially improve the outcome.
  • Help quarterback technical alignment around important deployments without replacing the teams responsible for deployment execution.
  • Serve as a liaison when complex technical issues require coordination beyond standard Support.
  • Help customers navigate capabilities across products such as Records, Fusus, AI Era, and the broader Axon ecosystem.
  • Connect the right resources across Product, Engineering, Support, Deployment, Training, Mission Operations, Mission Success, and Sales.
  • Continuously ask: What are we learning, what could work better, and what could we build so this is easier next time?
  • Return to the highest-value build opportunities once immediate customer needs are addressed.

Learn in the Field. Improve Axon.

  • Capture recurring customer needs, workflow patterns, and technical friction.
  • Share successful builds and lessons across Mission Engineering.
  • Bring platform limitations and customer insights back to Product and Engineering.
  • Identify solutions that could be reused by other MEs and agencies.

What You Bring

Required

  • Typically 3–5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, software engineering, systems, technical consulting, implementation engineering, or another hands-on technical role.
  • Foundational software engineering capability and demonstrated experience building technical solutions.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, scripting/ programming, data, testing, debugging, and modern development practices.
  • Understanding of AI concepts and practical applications.
  • Strong technical curiosity and ability to rapidly learn emerging platforms and tools.
  • Ability to solve ambiguous problems rather than simply execute predefined tasks.
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Customer-facing mindset and curiosity about how organizations actually operate.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain CJIS compliance and satisfy applicable agency background requirements.
  • Ability to maintain the onsite presence required by the engagement.

Preferred

  • Experience with Python, JavaScript, SQL, REST APIs, cloud platforms, or modern frameworks.
  • Experience with AI platforms, workflow automation, low-code development, or data.
  • Experience in public safety, defense, military, intelligence, government, or other mission-critical environments.

What Success Looks Like

You can take a meaningful customer problem through:

Discover → Build → Transform

Given Axon's approved toolkit, and a problem worth solving, you can turn it into a working solution and demonstrate whether it created value. And when the agency needs you elsewhere, you lean in without losing the engineering mindset—help solve the immediate need, identify what can be improved, and return to building.

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
  • Discretionary paid time off
  • Paid parental leave for all
  • Medical, Dental, Vision plans
  • Fitness Programs
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness support
  • Learning & Development programs


Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

title: Senior Data and AI Governance Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Data and AI Governance Analyst

Location: Guadalajara, Mexico, Hybrid

This is a hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Guadalajara, Mexico office as needed. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Own the data governance, AI governance, and DLP programs that earn and keep customer trust as Salesloft scales its AI-powered revenue platform.

As our Data Governance Senior Analyst, you’ll own and mature key parts of our data governance, AI governance, and DLP programs as a member of our fast-growing Governance, Risk, and Compliance team. Your work will make sure the customer data behind our Predictive Revenue System and the Revenue Context it delivers is classified, handled, and protected responsibly, including every data flow into and out of our AI systems. You’ll partner with Product and Engineering leadership to build privacy-by-design and responsible AI into new features early in the roadmap. In your first six months you will:

  • Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of our data governance program, including data classification, data handling standards, and data lifecycle and retention policies.
  • Build and operate our AI governance program, including AI policies and standards, an inventory of AI systems, models, and AI-enabled vendor tools, and a risk-based intake and approval process for new AI use cases.
  • Own configuration, monitoring, and tuning of our DLP tooling and controls, serving as the escalation point for complex or high-risk DLP alerts and data handling incidents.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE (our values, in this role)

  • Move as One: You’ll partner directly with Product, Engineering, Security, Sales, and Customer Success, and share credit when governance is built into the work from the start.
  • Evidence over Ego: You’ll ground every risk assessment and policy in real data flows, and say so when the evidence changes your mind.
  • Lead from the Front: You’ll own our data governance, AI governance, and DLP programs end to end, and mentor junior team members along the way.
  • Customer-Inspired: You’ll turn customer data governance, AI governance, and security questions into clear standards that earn their trust.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You’re a seasoned data and AI governance professional who balances regulatory rigor with practical business judgment, explains complex data handling and AI risk clearly to technical and executive audiences, and is excited to build something meaningful in a fast-moving SaaS environment. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOU’LL BRING (must-haves, max 5–6)

  • 5+ years in data governance, AI governance, DLP, information security, or a related compliance role (3+ with a Master’s degree, or equivalent work experience), working independently and reviewed primarily at critical milestones
  • Owned data governance frameworks with minimal oversight, including data inventories, data mapping, records of processing, retention schedules, and data classification
  • Hands-on experience with DLP tools and data classification/labeling technologies (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Symantec/Broadcom DLP, Netskope, Forcepoint, or similar), including independently investigating and remediating complex DLP alerts and data handling incidents
  • Working knowledge of AI governance and responsible AI practices (AI risk assessments, AI system and model inventories, model documentation, human oversight controls) and of how data flows through AI and machine learning systems, with familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act
  • Strong working knowledge of GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other major privacy regulations, plus privacy-by-design and data minimization principles, with a track record of influencing Product, Engineering, and Security leadership on data handling decisions
  • Strong project leadership and communication: you manage multiple workstreams, mentor others, build relationships with senior internal and external partners through persuasion and negotiation, and translate complex data handling, AI risk, and regulatory requirements into clear guidance for technical and executive audiences

IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

  • ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 experience
  • Experience leading data protection impact assessments (DPIAs/PIAs) for new products, features, and third-party relationships
  • Experience responding to complex customer data governance, AI governance, and security questionnaires and due diligence requests

THE TEAM
Our Salesloft Governance, Risk, and Compliance team is made up of seasoned and up-and-coming Compliance and Security professionals working toward one goal: earning and keeping customer trust as we scale our AI-powered revenue platform. We share intellectual curiosity, a bias toward action, a collaborative spirit, and a genuine commitment to doing the right thing for our customers, our employees, and our business. It’s a great place to grow your data governance expertise in a fast-paced, AI-forward environment.

BENEFITS:

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

title: Lead Salesforce Data Cloud Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Job Description :

About the Role :

We are looking for a Salesforce Data Cloud QA Engineer with strong hands-on experience in data validation, ETL/data-pipeline testing, Salesforce testing, and SQL-based data reconciliation. The role focuses on validating end-to-end data movement and transformation across multiple source systems into Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud Testing :

- Perform hands-on testing of Salesforce Data Cloud capabilities and data flows.

- Validate data ingestion from multiple source systems into Data Cloud.

- Validate Data Streams, DLOs, DMOs, mappings, transformations, and data harmonization.

- Verify that source data is correctly transformed and represented within Salesforce Data Cloud.

- Validate end-to-end data journeys from source systems through Data Cloud to downstream activation.

Data Validation & ETL Testing :

- Design and execute ETL/data-pipeline test scenarios.

- Perform source-to-target validation and reconciliation using strong SQL skills.

- Validate record counts, field-level mappings, data types, transformation rules, null/default handling, aggregations, business rules, and duplicate records.

- Validate incremental and full data loads.

- Test data refresh, synchronization, and failure/recovery scenarios.

- Identify data discrepancies and trace issues across the data pipeline.

SQL & Source-to-Target Reconciliation :

- Develop complex SQL queries to validate data across source and target systems.

- Perform reconciliation at record, field, aggregate, and business-rule levels.

- Validate data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity.

- Analyze large datasets and identify data anomalies.

- Create reusable SQL validation queries for regression testing.

Data Streams, DLO & DMO Validation :

- Validate Salesforce Data Cloud Data Streams and ingestion processes.

- Validate DLO and DMO mappings.

- Verify relationships between data objects.

- Validate transformations and calculated fields.

- Verify data harmonization across multiple source systems.

- Test mapping changes and their downstream impact.

Identity Resolution & Unified Profiles :

- Validate Identity Resolution rules and matching logic.

- Test duplicate and profile-matching scenarios across multiple source systems.

- Validate exact matches, partial matches, conflicting attributes, missing identifiers, duplicate profiles, false matches, and multiple-source customer records.

- Validate creation and maintenance of Unified Customer Profiles.

- Verify that the correct customer information is consolidated across systems.

Calculated Insights & Business Rules :

- Validate Calculated Insights against business requirements.

- Test aggregations, calculations, filters, and derived attributes.

- Validate rule-based scoring and scoring thresholds.

- Verify business-rule implementation and boundary conditions.

- Perform positive, negative, and boundary-value testing.

- Validate changes to calculations and their downstream impact.

Audience Segmentation & Activation Testing :

- Validate audience/segment creation based on defined business rules.

- Verify segment inclusion and exclusion criteria.

- Test boundary and negative scenarios for segmentation.

- Validate audience counts and member profiles against expected results.

- Validate activation outputs to downstream systems.

- Verify that the correct profiles/data are sent to target platforms.

API & Integration Testing :

- Perform API and integration testing across source systems, Salesforce Data Cloud, and downstream platforms.

- Validate request/response payloads, status codes, authentication, data mapping, and error handling.

- Test synchronous and asynchronous integrations.

- Validate retry, timeout, duplicate, and failure/recovery scenarios.

Required Skills :

- Salesforce Data Cloud

- Strong SQL

- ETL / Data Pipeline Testing

- Data Warehousing and Data Testing

- Source-to-target reconciliation

- Data quality and validation

- Data Streams, DLOs and DMOs

- Identity Resolution and Unified Profiles

- Calculated Insights and segmentation testing

- API Testing

- Integration Testing

- Strong defect analysis and troubleshooting

Preferred Skills :

- Snowflake

- Marketing Cloud Engagement

- Salesforce Personalization

- Financial services / mortgage domain experience

- Automation testing and CI/CD experience

Education :

- Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

title: Power Platform Administrator
description:
Role Purpose :

The Power Platform Administrator will support the Power Platform CoE by managing platform governance, administration, operational support, and troubleshooting across Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, and related services. The role ensures secure, consistent, and cost-effective adoption across markets.

Key Responsibilities :

- Administer and support Power Platform services, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, environments, connectors, and tenant settings.

- Manage governance controls such as environment strategy, Power Platform CoE Starter Kit, DLP policies, access controls, security roles, connector usage, and platform configuration standards.

- Provide support and troubleshooting for platform, access, configuration, capacity, billing, and tenant-wide integration issues.

- Support the rollout and governance of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and AI-enabled Power Platform capabilities across markets.

- Monitor usage, licensing, Dataverse capacity, AI credits, consumption, and billing risks, escalating concerns where required.

- Maintain CoE reports, dashboards, operational documentation, support procedures, and governance guidance.

- Coordinate with M365 Global Support, Security, Identity, Finance, Market D&T teams, Microsoft support, and other stakeholders to resolve incidents and manage risks.

- Support controlled change management for tenant-level or high-impact Power Platform changes.

Required Skills and Experience :

- BE/B Tech, MCA/BCA with 7+ years experience in above skills.

- Ready to work in Pune.

- Can join within 15 days.

- Experience administering Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Platform Admin Center, Dataverse, environments, connectors, security roles, DLP policies, and tenant settings.

- Understanding of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Copilot agents, AI Builder, licensing, capacity, and billing models is desirable.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, privileged access, security groups, service accounts, and least-privilege administration.

- Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, document procedures, communicate clearly, and work with global technical and business teams.

- Good understanding of ITIL-aligned incident, request, change, and problem management processes.

Ways of Working :

- Operate through approved admin accounts and follow privileged access, audit, and change management controls.

- Work with the Power Platform CoE shared service account and support mailbox to manage requests, incidents, governance activities, and stakeholder communication.

- Provide clear documentation, handover, and knowledge transfer to support continuity of CoE operations.

Success Measures :

- Power Platform environments are governed, documented, and managed to agreed standards.

- Copilot and agent rollout is supported with appropriate access, sharing, billing, and reporting controls.

- Support issues, capacity risks, licensing concerns, and billing risks are identified and managed promptly.

- Security, compliance, and change management expectations are consistently followed.

title: Generative AI Engineer - LLM/RAG
description:
Description :


Job Title : Generative AI Engineer (LLM Expert AWS Focus)


Location : Remote


Employment Type : Full-time


About BigRio :


BigRio is a Boston-based, remote-first technology consulting firm specializing in advanced data, cloud, and software engineering solutions. We partner with forward-thinking organizations to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance technologies, with deep expertise in AI/ML, data engineering, and AWS-native architectures.


Our clients span healthcare, life sciences, government, and enterprise sectors, and were known for tackling complex, high-impact challenges with cutting-edge innovation and measurable results.


About the Role :


Were seeking a hands-on Generative AI Engineer (LLM Expert) who combines strong AWS development experience (70%) with deep expertise in applied LLM engineering (30%).


This role is ideal for an engineer who has built real-world applications using OpenAI APIs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) not someone focused on traditional ML or model training. Youll work with BigRios internal AI team and client partners to design, build, and optimize LLM-powered features, integrating them into cloud-native, production-ready systems.


This is a senior technical role, not a research or experimental position. The focus is on building, shipping, and scaling LLM applications using OpenAI models, LangChain, and AWS infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities :


- Design, develop, and deploy AWS-based applications (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS, S3, Secrets Manager) that integrate LLM-powered features.


- Implement OpenAI-driven workflows, leveraging reasoning and non-reasoning models, temperature settings, and model versioning best practices.


- Apply prompt engineering and prompt chaining techniques to improve LLM accuracy and performance for production workloads.


- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines using LangChain, ChromaDB, or similar frameworks.


- Develop FastAPI or Flask-based backends that connect to OpenAI APIs and vector databases.


- Build interactive front-ends and tools using Gradio or Streamlit for rapid prototyping and testing.


- Ensure secure, containerized deployments using Docker and integrate SSO and role-based access controls.


- Automate data pipelines and document workflows via Google Drive, AWS SDKs, or REST APIs.


- Write production-grade Python code, following clean architecture, documentation, and CI/CD best practices.


- Collaborate closely with AI engineers, DevOps teams, and clients to deliver enterprise-ready LLM applications.


Required Qualifications :


- 5+ years of experience in professional software development, with a strong focus on AWS cloud and backend systems.


- 3+ years of direct experience working with OpenAI APIs, GPT models, and LLM application development.


- Proven ability to build and deploy LLM-powered applications, not just experiment with models.


- Expertise in Python, FastAPI, and API-driven architecture.


- Strong practical experience with LangChain, ChromaDB, RAG, and prompt engineering.


- Proficiency in Docker, AWS IAM, and secure deployment practices.


- Excellent communication skills ability to explain LLM behavior, tradeoffs, and reasoning clearly to both technical and non-technical teams.


- Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, client-facing environment across time zones.


Nice to Have :


- Experience with LangGraph or other LLM orchestration frameworks.


- Knowledge of vector databases like Pinecone or FAISS.


- Familiarity with MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, and observability for LLM workloads.


- Exposure to healthcare, biotech, or regulated data environments.


- Demonstrated experience explaining and documenting AI system design and decision-making for non-AI stakeholders.

title: PowerApps Developer
description:
